long_description:
**Join us on August 29 as we discuss** ***Ten Incarnations of Rebellion*** **by Vaishnavi Patel.**
**From the bestselling author of** ***Kaikeyi*** **comes a bold and imaginative novel that blends mythology, history, and fantasy into a sweeping story of resistance and revolution. Inspired by the ten avatars of Vishnu from Hindu mythology,** ***Ten Incarnations of Rebellion*** **reimagines these legendary figures across different eras, exploring what it means to challenge injustice, confront power, and fight for a better world.**
**Through interconnected stories that span centuries, Patel examines themes of duty, identity, sacrifice, and social change. Drawing on familiar mythological traditions while giving voice to characters often overlooked in the original tales, she creates a rich and thought-provoking narrative that feels both timeless and strikingly relevant to contemporary conversations about power and resistance.**
**Whether you're a longtime fan of mythology, enjoy speculative fiction, or are simply curious about modern retellings of classic stories, this book offers plenty to discuss. As always, we'll explore the themes, characters, and cultural context of the novel while enjoying great food and conversation.**
**Our discussions are welcoming and informal, and everyone is encouraged to participate at whatever level feels comfortable. Finished the book? Great. Only made it partway through? Come anyway. The conversation is always richer when we bring together different perspectives.**
**📖 Book:** ***Ten Incarnations of Rebellion*** **by Vaishnavi Patel**
**📅 Date: August 29**
**📍 Location: Peppino’s Dosa**
**Come for the fiction, stay for the food and fellowship.**

You’ll be invited to reflect on what you wish to release, identify what’s no longer serving you, and set intentions for what you want to welcome in. The Full Moon’s illumination helps reveal hidden emotions and patterns, allowing you to let go with clarity and step forward with confidence, purpose, and trust in yourself.

Once your mind and heart are open, surrender fully into a sound bath in nature. Let the healing frequencies of crystal singing bowls wash over you, bringing deep relaxation and emotional restoration. Feel the gentle rhythm of the ocean harmonize with the sound vibrations as you reach deeper states of calm, balance, and inner peace.

End the evening with a moonlit social hour, a time to connect, share, and celebrate with like-minded souls. Bring snacks and drinks to enjoy as you bask in the moonlight and ocean breeze.

title: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening
description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. long_description:
As we continue on our year-long investigation of all things 1776 - We're going to learn about attitudes and treatments of mental illness during Revolutionary times.

"Mad" King George refers to King George III of Great Britain and Ireland, who ruled from 1760 to 1820. Best known for losing the American colonies and suffering from bouts of severe mental illness.

In 1773, the first hospital in the United States designed solely for the treatment of people living with mental illness was opened in Williamsburg, Virginia.

Hope you will join us to learn more about this subject.

If you can't join us - you might take a look at this website:
[Mental Illness timeline by Georgia College](https://georgialibraries.omeka.net/s/central-state-hospital/page/history-mental-health)

long_description:
## **An Educational Series**

### **Session One: Psilocybin — Healing, Science & Sacred Tradition**

Curious about psilocybin but unsure where to begin?

Whether you're exploring this medicine for the first time, supporting someone on their healing journey, or simply wanting to better understand the growing body of research, this educational gathering offers a welcoming space to learn, ask questions, and engage in thoughtful conversation.

Together we'll explore psilocybin through multiple lenses—Indigenous traditions, modern clinical research, harm reduction, and personal preparation—while honoring both the ancient wisdom and contemporary science surrounding this remarkable medicine.

### During this session we'll explore:

🍄 The history and traditional relationship with psilocybin-containing mushrooms
🧠 Current research on mental health, neuroplasticity, trauma, depression, anxiety, addiction, and end-of-life care
🛡️ Harm reduction principles and safety considerations
🌿 Set & Setting: creating supportive internal and external environments
💛 Physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual preparation
✨ Intention setting and respectful approaches to working with sacred medicines
🌱 The importance of integration and how meaningful healing continues long after the experience itself
📚 Educational resources for continued learning
This gathering is intended for educational purposes and community discussion. It is designed to empower participants with balanced, evidence-informed knowledge while honoring the Indigenous communities who have stewarded many of these sacred medicines for generations.
Whether you're simply curious or already walking your own healing path, all are welcome.

***

## Your Facilitators

This series is facilitated by Andrea Taahaabaah Twitchell and guest facilitators of The Medicine Way. Andrea is an Indigenous educator, therapeutic bodyworker, spiritual coach, and founder of The Medicine Way, a nonprofit holistic spiritual community dedicated to healing

title: Sip & Flow at Boyd Cru Wines
description: Start with yoga, end with wine.
long_description:
Start with yoga, end with wine.

About this Event

Here is your permission slip to slow down, show up, and have a little fun.
First, we flow. Move, breathe, and shake off the week with intention. No experience required. No pressure to look a certain way. Just you, your breath, and good company.
Then we pour. We gather around one featured wine and dig into the good stuff together. Where is it from? Who made it? What is the story in the glass, the land, the people, the history, the culture? You will walk out knowing how to find bottles like it on your own, so you can shop and sip smarter.
We are so excited to partner with Boyd Cru Wines, a winery that brings people together through refined wines that tell a story.
This is not a lecture, and it is not a splurge. It is your people, your ritual, your weekend kickoff. Come as you are, pour yourself something lovely, and toast to you.
Sip & Flow is hosted on the last Saturday of every month at special locations across the DMV. On August 29th, we'll explore a slow flow, allowing movement to bring peace to the mind and nervous system as we stretch and strengthen the body. 
BRING YOUR OWN MAT.

long_description: Join Molly for an afternoon of rest and sound healing. This summer, E+ROSE is partnering with Good Karma Wellness, a community-driven wellness platform focused on making wellness accessible, social, and fun. Through curated events and experiences, Good Karma brings people together to move their bodies, connect with others, and discover new ways to prioritize their well-being—without it feeling overwhelming or exclusive.
At E+ROSE Wellness Company, we believe food is medicine—but true wellness is about so much more. Movement, connection, and community are essential parts of feeling your best.
Join us for a feel-good yoga session with Highland Yoga that celebrates movement, community, and starting your weekend strong. You'll experience a yoga class designed to challenge and energize you. For more information, check out both studios on socials: @highlandyoga_nashville!
The first 30 attendees will receive a Good Karma goody bag! After class, stick around for complimentary cold plunges sponsored by Pause, then enjoy an exclusive post-workout discount at E+ROSE ONEC1TY to refuel, recharge, and treat yourself ◡̈

long_description:
This is unaffiliated but a free (donation-based) class that I’ve enjoyed so figured I’d post the info for anyone interested in joining in! The space is very attuned for meditation and spiritual practice. Again, I’m just a fellow student!

From their website:

Experience the Unique Power of Himalayan Yoga

As taught by the yogis from the Himalayas— Himalayan Yoga combines gentle postures, breathwork, and mindful relaxation techniques to connect body, mind, and spirit resulting in healing from within. Whether you’re new or experienced, this practice will leave you feeling relaxed, focused, and rejuvenated.

Benefits of Himalayan Yoga:

🌿 Enhanced flexibility, balance, and holistic strength
🌿 Tools/Techniques to cope with stress, anxiety and bring mental clarity
🌿 Energizing breathwork to uplift and restore overall health

💲 Pricing: Heartfelt donations ($10 suggested or pay what your heart desires and what you can…). All donations will go to support The Meditation Center.

📍 Location, parking & other essentials: The Meditation Center (TMC), 631 University Avenue NE, Minneapolis, MN 55413. Free parking is available across the street from TMC in the Church’s parking lot. Bring a water bottle. Yoga mat, pillows and blankets provided. Please arrive 5 minutes early and get comfortable in “the Hall of Tradition” on the main floor. No registration needed.

About Your Instructor:

Sunita Bhardwaj Gangopadhyay brings 18 years of affiliation in the Himalayan Yoga and meditation tradition. She has completed a 200-hour Teacher Training Program with Himalayan Yoga. Dedicated to helping students find balance and peace, Sunita focuses on making each class accessible and rewarding, regardless of experience level. Sunita has a PhD in Physics and a retired executive who worked in high tech industry for 25 years. She is currently the president of the Board at The Meditation Center. Native of India, Sunita currently lives in Eden Prairie, MN. She is married with two children.

long_description:
*How much of the abundance in our lives goes unnoticed because our attention is focused on what is missing?*

*What if we could experience more abundance and love by discovering the fullness of what is already here?*

In this gathering, we’ll explore how shifting from a scarcity orientation to an abundance orientation changes the way we experience and create our lives. This isn’t about denying desire or forcing positivity. It’s about recognizing the love, relationships, strengths, beauty, resources, and opportunities already present—and creating from that place of fullness rather than deficiency.

**SHARED INTENTION**
To cultivate an orientation of abundance that helps us experience more of what’s already here and create more of what we want, need, and love.

**ABUNDANCE PRINCIPLES WE'LL EXPLORE...**

* Abundance as a present reality — noticing what is already available within and around us
* Abundance as a creative orientation — building our lives from possibility instead of lack
* How abundance and desire can coexist — feeling full *and* still wanting more

**WHAT WE'RE CULTIVATING**
The capacity to notice, receive, appreciate, and create from the love and resources already present—so we can live and move with more ease, clarity, and joy.

You’ll leave with a clearer sense of what’s already supporting you, and a more grounded ability to create from fullness instead of lack.

This will be a warm, reflective conversation where we slow down, share honestly, and practice seeing our lives through a wider lens—together.

Come as you are. No performance required. Just a willingness to look at your life with fresh eyes.

**About the Love on Earth Series**
Love on Earth is a series exploring what it means to intentionally build lives, relationships, and communities where love becomes more practiced, embodied, felt, and real.
In our community, we don't just talk about love—we practice it in ways that are grounded, relational, and real.

title: Come Undone | Community Breathwork in Denver Metro
description: A sacred, 2-hour journey, designed to ignite your inner light through the ancient practice of rhythmic breathwork.
long_description:
A sacred, 2-hour journey, designed to ignite your inner light through the ancient practice of rhythmic breathwork.

About this Event

This is a two-hour community ceremony using the modality of holotropic breathwork. No experience required. No performance expected.
Just you, your breath, and up to fourteen people doing the same brave thing.
We'll use breath, music, and light movement to support you in accessing what's sitting underneath the surface — old stories, stuck emotion, the stuff that talking doesn't always reach.
The flow:
Arrive up to 10 minutes prior to the official start to get settledA grounded introduction to breathwork and this particular styleCo-created safety: share your name, where you're at, and your intention if you'd likeActive breathing to a curated playlist that carries you through the experienceAn optional release moment — scream, tap, hum, sing, shake — whatever your body asks forIntegration time: rest, write, draw, and/or verbally connect with the groupWhat this might bring up:
Holotropic breathwork works with the body's own intelligence. You might feel emotional, physical, or somewhere in between. You might cry, laugh, feel nothing, or feel everything. All of it is welcome. Nothing needs to be performed or produced. In here, we let the body body.
This is a space to process, not to present, perform or perfect.
What to bring:
Comfortable, non-restrictive clothingYoga mat or a surface you can lie on for a couple of hoursBlanketPillow or bolster (doubles as your scream buffer, no shame)Journal, pen, colored pencils Eye coverWaterChaptstick, vaselineCrystals, cards, totems, etc

Victoria Cumberbatch is a PCC level ADHD resilience coach, holotropic breathwork facilitator, and the founder of Victorious Coaching. Her approach blends somatics, cognitive behaviorism, cultural intersectionality all through a neurodivergent lens. Find more at victoriouscoach.com/linkz.

long_description:
Hey Poetry Lovers!

This group is on a roll. Here’s the gist:

We meet at the **Capital One Café in Chinatown** from **12pm - 2pm** every other week.

For enrichment, we start by reading and reflecting on a **“published poem”**, suggested by someone in the group. No advance preparation is necessary. But feel free to check out some of the poems we’ve read [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vSyE_wCLQCPHRrKmN5F9tOIeeRQUZESxjRXGVBoCF2uU8Gm0_d0uECiCBCQXEy6ksxfsBOhtRIOpW3T/pubhtml?gid=0&single=true&widget=true&headers=false%22%3E%3C/iframe%3E). Or submit suggestions for future meetings [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSexGc2Z2Kp6bZW0D3_hfJ7NUUkfNHf7TXX-43FglCeBd9EF2Q/viewform?usp=send_form).

Next, we **share our work and offer feedback**. Depending on attendance, everyone gets \~10 minutes to use as they like. (No need to share, though; you’re welcome to come even if you prefer just to listen.)

We maintain a **Discord server** to help share our work and communicate outside our bi-weekly meet-ups. If you haven’t used Discord before, take a moment to download it and create an account before arriving. When we meet you on Saturday, we will add you to our server, the “DC Poetry Workshop”, and can help you navigate the app if you have questions.

Finally, if you plan on sharing a poem, consider how you will do so. Some options include:

* Print 5-10 copies to distribute in person
* Take and share screenshots in the Discord chat.
* Copy the poem into a google doc, change sharing settings to “anyone with link”, and copy the google doc link into the Discord chat.

Most importantly, we’re excited to meet you!

Catch you on Saturday,

Diego / Ian / Cayden / Nate / Otasha / Lia / An

long_description:
Candlelit breathwork, gentle yoga, and deep relaxation to help you unwind, reset, and leave grounded and restored.

About this Event

Step into a candlelit sanctuary intentionally designed to help you slow down, reconnect, and restore.
Through mindful breathwork, gentle Hatha yoga, and guided relaxation, you’ll be invited into a slower rhythm, one that allows the body to soften, the mind to settle, and the nervous system to unwind. Surrounded by the warm glow of candlelight and calming instrumental music, every element of the evening has been intentionally curated for you, down to details you’ll only discover once you arrive.
The evening unfolds as one continuous journey: guided breathwork and meditation to quiet the day, a gentle beginner-friendly yoga flow to release tension, and an extended full-body relaxation to close. In the final moments, you’ll receive a cooling aromatherapy towel prepared in your choice of lavender or peppermint, one last invitation to release the day before returning home.
Whether you’re stepping onto a mat for the very first time or returning to a long-loved practice, you are welcome exactly as you are. Modifications are offered throughout, and nothing is ever asked of you but presence.
Come as you are. Leave grounded, restored, and renewed.
The day will ask everything of you. This hour asks nothing.
Come lay it all down: the noise, the pace, the weight you didn’t realize you were carrying. Breathe by candlelight. Move slowly, softly, honestly. Rest deeper than you have in a long while.
Your mat is waiting. Reserve your space at the inaugural Candlelit Reset™.

organizer: Mantra House Kirtan Bhakti Yoga Meditation and More
long_description:
The Bhagavad Gita is one of the most influential and enduring texts of yoga philosophy, dating back over 2,000 years. Long before yoga became associated primarily with physical
postures, the Gita explored the inner science of action, awareness, and purpose. It offers a framework not just for practice-but for living.

We do this through:

•Gentle Yoga and embodiment
•Breath practices for clarity and grounding
•Art therapy to process insight
•Bite-sized Gita wisdom explained in modern language
•Guided reflection for personal application
•Journalling and Tea circles
No prior knowledge of the Gita is required.

This is not a lecture or traditional study circle - it is a lived experience of timeless wisdom made accessible for modern life.

This offering is designed for:

•Spiritually curious individuals
•Yoga practitioners seeking philosophical depth
•Those exploring meaning and purpose
•People feeling stuck in overthinking or indecision
•Community members wanting interactive spiritual exploration
For those both familiar with and brand new to Bhakti Yoga (Indian and non-Indian
Backgrounds)
The tone is inclusive, accessible, and welcoming to all backgrounds.

-Asana trains the body.

-Pranayama refines the breath.

-But the Gita trains the mind, intention, and inner orientation.

The Gita expands on essential yogic principles often mentioned in the Yoga Sutras of Patanjali:

• Acting without attachment to results (karma yoga)

• Steadying the mind in uncertainty

• Sustaining effort without burnout

• Aligning action with dharma - purposeful living

While many yoga classes strengthen the body, Living the Gita explores how yogic wisdom

shapes decision-making, resilience, and clarity in everyday life. This 90-minute multi-sensory experience weaves movement, creativity, reflection, and dialogue to bring these
teachings off the page and into embodied practice.

This is yoga off the mat - not just how we move, but how we choose, respond, and live.

Mark your calendars for the 30th of August, 2026, because the San Diego Tamil Sangam is holding its Fun-Filled Summer Picnic. This event is a delightful blend of Tamil traditions and multilingual exchanges, coupled with the irresistible charm of delicious food and drink exhibitions. Immerse yourself in the vibrant Tamil culture, and enjoy a day full of fun, laughter, and great food.
Presenting the Art of Tamil Culture
While this year's artist is not mentioned, the event is assured to be a vibrant showcase of the rich Tamil heritage and culture. The San Diego Tamil Sangam, our esteemed organizer, has always been the torchbearer of Tamil culture in California, bringing in artists who are deeply rooted in Tamil traditions and arts. The performances at the event are sure to captivate the audience, taking them on a journey through the richness and diversity of Tamil culture.
Relish the Day at the Scenic Hilltop Community Park
The event takes place at the beautiful Hilltop Community Park, located at 9711 Oviedo Way, San Diego, CA, United States. The park is known for its breathtaking views and serene environment. It's easily accessible, ensuring a hassle-free commute for everyone. Safety is a top priority at Hilltop Community Park, making it an ideal venue for family outings. After the event, you can explore the many nearby attractions that San Diego has to offer. If you're a fan of Indian cuisine, there are a number of excellent Indian restaurants in the vicinity that you can visit.

title: Expand & Embody: Outdoor Yoga Series – Class 8 (Embodying)
description: A FREE outdoor yoga integrating all 7 chakras through movement,  breath and mindful practice. Open to all levels.
long_description:
A FREE outdoor yoga integrating all 7 chakras through movement, breath and mindful practice. Open to all levels.

About this Event

Expand & Embody is a FREE outdoor yoga series rooted in the belief that yoga isn’t just something we do on the mat. It’s a practice that helps us move through life with greater awareness, resilience, and ease.

Each class explores a different theme through intentional movement, breath, and reflection, creating space to strengthen both the body and the nervous system. Whether you’re brand new to yoga or have an established practice, you’ll be guided through an experience designed to leave you feeling more grounded, more present, and more capable of meeting life beyond the mat.

Class 8: Embodying (Full Chakra Activation)
Our final class brings together everything we’ve explored throughout the series. Rather than focusing on a single energy center, we’ll move through a full chakra practice that honors the interconnectedness of the body, mind, and breath. Through intentional movement, breath, and mindful awareness, we’ll revisit the themes of grounding, feeling, empowering, connecting, expressing, seeing, and expanding, weaving them into one integrated experience. This practice reminds us that embodiment isn’t about mastering yoga, it’s about allowing what we’ve practiced on the mat to become part of how we move through everyday life.

What to Expect

title: Sonu Nigam Live Concert In Los Angeles | Revolution Tour 2026
description: Experience the Magic of Melodies at Sonu Nigam Live Concert in Los Angeles | Revolution Tour 2026
long_description:
Experience the Magic of Melodies at Sonu Nigam Live Concert in Los Angeles | Revolution Tour 2026
Prepare to be captivated by the enchanting voice of Sonu Nigam at the much-anticipated Revolution Tour 2026. On the 30th of August, 2026, the Indian music maestro will step onto the stage of the Dolby Theatre, Los Angeles, to deliver a memorable performance. The event, organized by the Sankara Eye Foundation, promises an evening filled with melodious Hindi and multilingual songs from the world of Indian cinema. This live concert is a must-attend for all music enthusiasts who appreciate the art of singing.
Sonu Nigam: The Resounding Voice of Indian Cinema
Hailing from a humble Bengali family, Sonu Nigam is now one of the most celebrated figures in the Indian music industry. He is not just a playback singer but a symbol of versatility and dedication. His journey, from his debut in Janam to hosting the popular music show Sa Re Ga Ma, is truly inspirational. Nigam has sung in various Indian languages and has been lauded with prestigious awards, including a nomination for the Oscars in 2015. His unique voice and exceptional talent have made him one of the highest-paid singers in the industry, and his presence at the Revolution Tour 2026 is set to make the event unforgettable.
Experience the Grandeur of Dolby Theatre
The Dolby Theatre, located at 6801 Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles, CA, United States, is renowned for hosting high-profile events. This iconic venue assures safety, accessibility, and comfort to all its guests. Its location in Hollywood offers a plethora of attractions, including historic sites and trendy boutiques. Parking is available on-site for your convenience. Enjoy a pre-show dinner at one of the nearby Indian restaurants, offering a variety of authentic dishes that perfectly complement the evening.
Secure Your Seat for the Musical Extravaganza
Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to witness Sonu Nigam live in concert. Standard Admission tickets are available for $115.00. Secure your seat today and get ready to immerse yourself in the soulful melodies of Indian cinema, delivered by the inimitable Sonu Nigam.

title: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening
description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. W

Guiding your journey on the 1st, 3rd, & 5th weeks of the month is Kristin, a dedicated RYT-200 certified yoga teacher with trauma-informed training from Satya Yoga Co-Op (2022). A familiar face at The Karma House since 2021, Kristin has thoughtfully led Yoga & Tea sessions and cultivated a nurturing, inclusive space for all.

On the 2nd and 4th weeks Julie Zook lovingly leads. (Bio pending)

**🌿 About The Karma House**
The Karma House isn’t your average bar — we’re an alcohol-free kava bar and community hub in Lakewood, CO. Our space was created to bring people together through music, art, wellness, and connection. From live shows to poetry nights to wellness workshops, everything we do centers around community and creating a safe, welcoming atmosphere for all.
**🥥 What is a Kava Bar?**
Kava bars are unique gathering places where people come to connect and unwind without alcohol. Instead of cocktails, we serve traditional Polynesian kava — a calming root tea that has been used for centuries in the South Pacific for relaxation, stress relief, and social connection.
**🍵 What is Kava?**
Kava is made from the root of the Piper methysticum plant. It has gentle, grounding effects that can help calm the body and quiet the mind, making it perfect for relaxing, connecting, and enjoying good company. At The Karma House, we prepare our shells of kava with care and community in mind — it’s more than a drink, it’s a ritual of connection.

title: Home-Cooked Software: Building Personal Apps with Obsidian
description:

Robin Sloan once built a messaging app just for his family: four users, zero churn, no plans to scale. He called it "home-cooked software"—programming liberated from the requirement to be professional, the way cooking at home is nothing like cooking in a commercial kitchen. Maggie Appleton later extended the idea to a whole category of "barefoot programmers" building local-first tools for themselves.

This talk is about bringing that same spirit to the tools you use
long_description:
Presented by **Chazona Baum**
Robin Sloan once built a messaging app just for his family: four users, zero churn, no plans to scale. He called it "home-cooked software"—programming liberated from the requirement to be professional, the way cooking at home is nothing like cooking in a commercial kitchen. Maggie Appleton later extended the idea to a whole category of "barefoot programmers" building local-first tools for themselves.

This talk is about bringing that same spirit to the tools you use every day. What if your reading list, your task board, your time tracker, or your job search lived as plain markdown files in an Obsidian vault—readable in any text editor, syncable with any file service, and wrapped in a simple desktop app that gives you a nicer interface than raw files?

We'll look at several real apps that do exactly this, from a consultant's time budget tracker to a personal job search pipeline, talk about what kinds of problems are good (and bad) fits for this approach, and then get hands-on. You'll leave with a starter project and a working (or at least started) personal app of your own.

**What to bring:** A laptop with Node.js installed and Obsidian (free) with any vault set up, even an empty one. No framework experience needed; we'll use vanilla JS.

All skill levels welcome! The [757Dev Community](757dev.org) means a lot to me, and I thank each of you for your support. 🖖

As always, HUGE thanks to Assembly for hosting. Learn more about the amenities and community of Assembly at [https://www.assemblynfk.com/](https://www.assemblynfk.com/)

Street parking is free after 6 pm. From 6:30-7:00 pm, we will have someone at the door to let you in. After 7, message the #javascript channel on 757Dev Slack. We meet in the Fur Room on the 4th floor.

**Yoga Nidra: A Journey Within with Noella**

**August 31st @ 6:30 PM**

**Energy Exchange: $18**
Step away from the noise of the outside world and embark on a deeply restorative inner journey through the practice of Yoga Nidra, often called “yogic sleep.” This guided meditation experience invites you into a state of conscious relaxation where the body rests, the mind softens, and the spirit has space to reconnect with its natural wisdom.
During this class, you will be gently guided through gentle movement, breath awareness, body relaxation, visualization, and meditation practices designed to calm the nervous system, release stress, and cultivate inner peace. No yoga experience is necessary. Simply come as you are and allow yourself to receive.
Yoga Nidra can support:

• Deep relaxation and stress relief

• Improved sleep and emotional balance

• Mental clarity and focus

• Nervous system restoration

• Greater self-awareness and inner connection
Bring a yoga mat, blanket, pillow, and anything else that will help you feel comfortable and supported while lying down for an extended period of time.
Join us for an evening of rest, renewal, and self-discovery as you journey inward and reconnect with the quiet wisdom that lives within.
All are welcome.

**See how Grok Lead Finder discovers high-potential businesses, validates what happened, identifies the right decision-makers, and prioritizes who deserves attention now—all within a repeatable workflow built to improve with every run.**

Cracked Claude Cowork and Codex Club aims to be the 2026, Phoenix, AI version of the [Homebrew Computer Club](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homebrew_Computer_Club) of the 1970s, where Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak met Paul Terrell, who gave Apple its first major order of 50 Apple I computers.
Though accessible and welcoming to anyone, some of the discussion may fly over your head if you are not already comfortable with AI (Claude/Codex/Gemini/Grok). Please join us if you'd like to keep your finger on the pulse of the frontier of capability of these models and more.
Each session is divided into three parts:

* 20-minute demo of our most impressive projects from the previous month, along with sharing our new best practices.
* 30-45min interactive and AI-assisted group discussions and friendly debates using an innovative app built and maintained just for this Meetup group.
* 15-30min Guest speaker + demo
* Networking

We're [automationinterns.com,](http://automationinterns.com,/) a rapidly growing group of ASU engineering grads and top students forward-deployed in about a dozen local Phoenix businesses. We specialize in both rapid deployment of custom software and general AI implementation consulting.

long_description:
NOTE: Hybrid event, speaker is virtual

Azure DocumentDB brings a flexible, open-source MongoDB-compatible document database that is actually compatible with other cloud providers.
In this 50-minute session, we’ll unpack Azure DocumentDB from the perspective of a SQL and MongoDB professional. You’ll learn
\- how DocumentDB’s architecture works including its Postgres foundation and MongoDB wire\-protocol compatibility
\- how its JSON document model compares to relational data design
\- where transactions\, indexing\, and consistency behave differently or same as SQL Server\.
\- scaling\, global distribution\, security\, and indexing strategies\.
We’ll walk step-by-step from familiar T-SQL concepts into the DocumentDB world: inserting schema-free documents, querying with MongoDB operators, tuning performance with indexes and the Index Advisor, and scaling a cluster in the Azure Portal. We’ll also compare DocumentDB to MongoDB and discuss if/when DocumentDB is the better operational choice on Azure (and other clouds).
Whether you're supporting enterprise SQL workloads, considering NoSQL for new microservices, or evaluating MongoDB alternatives, this session will give you a practical mental model, concrete examples, and a clear understanding of how (and when) to use Azure DocumentDB effectively.

long_description:
**Presenter:** Matthew Hess, Microsoft MVP
**Time:** Pizza at 6:00, Presentation Starts at 6:30pm Eastern
**Location:** Theoris, 9000 Keystone Crossing, Either Downstairs or in Suite 230 if main meeting room isn't available, Indianapolis

As a C# developer, it can be a challenge to keep up with all the new language features that Microsoft gives us. Old code still compiles, and old habits die hard. In this presentation we'll look at some of my very favorite new(ish) language features. These are things I use every day:

• Pattern Matching Switch Expressions (C# 8 and C# 9) - So versatile
• Target Typed New Constructors (C# 9) - Say goodbye to "var"
• Value Tuples (C# 7) - Underutilized and powerful
• String Interpolation (C# 6) - Not really new, but are you using it?
• Collection Expressions with Spread (C# 12) - Even easier initialization
• Null Conditional Assignment (C# 14) - At last!

Looking forward to seeing you there!

description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. long_description:
Join us for a ChatBTV meetup!

We're living through one of the biggest shifts in our industry, possibly ever. ChatBTV is a space for developers, designers, and tech folks to workshop it together. Come learn, see a demo, share what's working, what's not, and connect with other folks that are trying to make sense of it all.

**This months speaker:**

Ron Northcutt, Open Source & Applied AI

Omnideck, an open source AI studio that doesn't forget

An agent can write you a useful tool in thirty seconds. Keeping that tool alive until Monday, wired to live credentials, and locked out of root on your laptop is the actual engineering problem. Almost nobody is working on it. The industry shipped a good text box and called it a product.

omnideck is what we built instead. It's an open source, local-first studio where what you ask for becomes a real artifact, one that persists, re-runs, and stays inside a boundary you control. Building it meant answering questions that don't fit on a launch slide. Where does agent-generated code actually execute? Who holds the tokens, and how do you give an agent access without giving it the keys? What counts as the unit of isolation when one person runs work for four clients on one machine? Then there's model choice, which we settled per agent rather than betting the whole system on a single vendor.

Ron walks through the architecture behind those answers. The runtime, the deck model, container sandboxing, the credential broker, sub-agents, and more. Then the slides close and he builds something live. You can too.

This talk will be followed by community discussion. These are certainly interesting times to be a human being tasked with creating software - let's come together and have each other's backs. See you there!

What to expect:

* A talk/demo
* Open discussion and Q&A
* Networking with Burlington-area folks

organizer: Denver Entrepreneurship Through Acquisition ETA Meetup
long_description:
Hosted on the first Wednesday of every month, this is a casual and low-key event to get to know the Denver ETA community better. This is suited for those new to Entrepreneurship Through Acquisition or seasoned investors. We discuss people's past experiences in acquisitions, startups, and the corporate world across various industries.

Collectively, the search community is a powerful one. Both the process of looking for a business and operating one post-acquisition can be an incredibly challenging road.

This month, we’re bringing in **Trevor Crow** to talk about ETA transactions from the lawyer’s side of the table:

* what buyers should be thinking about
* where deals tend to get hung up
* which provisions actually matter when you’re trying to get a deal across the finish line

Whether you’re actively searching, under LOI, already operating, or still trying to figure out the difference between an indemnity and an escrow, come join us for a practical conversation about the legal side of buying a business.

organizer: Las Vegas Indians and Indian Culture lovers Meetup
long_description:
Mantra Yoga

Mantra Yoga is a meditative sound practice that activates healing, clarity, and awareness through the vibration of your own voice. Whether spoken, whispered, or chanted, each mantra becomes a tool for transformation.

In this class, we explore the pronunciation, meaning, and energy of sacred mantras. You may have heard them in Kundalini Yoga or other tradition and held back—this is your chance to deepen into their sound and fully experience their power.

Each session evolves organically, beginning with guided recitation, followed by call-and-response chanting, and devotional sound journeys. You’ll be supported by live harmonium, and from time to time, guest musicians who bring added depth to the experience.

Even if it’s your first time, all you need is an open heart. You’ll leave feeling lighter, more connected, and empowered by the vibration that lives within you.

Benefits include:
• Calms the mind and relieves anxiety
• Clears subconscious patterns and emotional blocks
• Strengthens vocal confidence and breath control
• Activates energy centers (chakras)
• Increases mental focus and inner peace
• Deepens meditation and devotional awareness
• Uplifts the spirit and fosters joy
• Awaken the power of your own voice.

A journey into healing sound, sacred words, and the vibration of consciousness. Let your voice lead the way. All levels welcome.

What to bring:
Wear comfortable clothes (white cotton is suggested for its uplifting energy, but not required.)

title: Money That Thinks for Itself
description:
A Hawaii Tech Week masterclass on programmable money, with Sean Cover of Eco

***Speaker:*** Sean Cover is Chief Financial Officer at Eco, the stablecoin network making money programmable. Eco connects major blockchains so that dollars can move like internet traffic — routed, automated, and executed across trading, treasury, and FX without a person pushing the button. Sean is also the author of *The Story of Money: The Journey From Shells and Shekels to Bills and Bitcoin,* and he's based right h
long_description:
A Hawaii Tech Week masterclass on programmable money, with Sean Cover of Eco

***Speaker:*** Sean Cover is Chief Financial Officer at Eco, the stablecoin network making money programmable. Eco connects major blockchains so that dollars can move like internet traffic — routed, automated, and executed across trading, treasury, and FX without a person pushing the button. Sean is also the author of *The Story of Money: The Journey From Shells and Shekels to Bills and Bitcoin,* and he's based right here in Honolulu.

Money doesn't move unless you tell it to. It doesn't know where to go, when to go, or why. It just sits there and waits.
AI and crypto are changing that in ways most people aren't paying attention to yet. Money is becoming programmable. It can follow rules, move on its own, and get smarter over time.
Sean Cover has been building at this intersection at Eco. In this masterclass, he'll break down how programmable money actually works, what it means when transactions can think for themselves, and why money is about to get a whole lot smarter.
You'll leave understanding:
What "programmable money" actually is
How AI agents and crypto rails work together to move money automatically
Why this shift matters for Hawaiʻi, and how to get ahead of it instead of catching up later

No crypto experience needed. Come curious.

RSVP here: https://luma.com/r9qeh7kf

*Hosted by Pūpūkahi Tech Foundation — closing the digital economy gap for Hawaiʻi's local communities through technology access, digital education, and fluency in AI, Web3, and cryptocurrency.*

long_description:
Register here: https://www.fcmakers.org/workshops/31

### About this Workshop

This **CNC 101 workshop** is a beginner-friendly, hands-on introduction to computer-controlled machining using the **Shapeoko 5 Pro** CNC Router. Designed for makers with little to no CNC experience, this class will walk you through the complete workflow from digital design to a finished part while emphasizing safe and proper use of the machine.
Participants will learn how CNC routers work, what materials can be used, and how to prepare and run jobs on the Shapeoko Pro. By the end of the workshop, you’ll understand how to securely set up material, load tools, and confidently run a basic CNC program.

#### What You’ll Learn

* What CNC milling is and how it differs from 3D printing and laser cutting
* Overview of the Shapeoko Pro and its capabilities
* Safety procedures and best practices
* Basic tooling and materials (wood, plastics, aluminum)
* How to prepare a simple design for CNC machining
* Workholding, zeroing, and running a job on the Shapeoko Pro

#### What’s Included

* Live demonstration of the Shapeoko Pro CNC
* Guided walkthrough of a sample project
* Creation of your own V-carve sign

#### Who This Workshop Is For

* Beginners with no prior CNC experience
* Makers interested in precision parts, woodworking, artistic projects
* Members looking to earn CNC access at the makerspace

#### After the Workshop

Participants who successfully complete CNC 101 will be eligible to enroll in the CNC 102 workshop. After completing both 101 and 102 workshop, participants will be certified to use the Shapeoko Pro 4' x 4' cnc router.
Requirements

* Bring a laptop with Carbide Create installed. Download it for free [here](https://carbide3d.com/carbidecreate/). Available for both Mac and Windows.
* Participants must be over the age of 14 to attend and over 18 to obtain makerspace membership

Register here: https://www.fcmakers.org/workshops/31

title: Breaking the Stigma: YOGA
description: Breaking the Stigma: Yoga will be a community experience that combines conversation, connection, food, and practice.
long_description:
Breaking the Stigma: Yoga will be a community experience that combines conversation, connection, food, and practice.

About this Event

We will begin by sharing a meal and engaging in conversation with yoga practitioners. Together, we will explore questions about the history and spiritual significance of yoga, how the practice has evolved, and what it means to engage with yoga in today's world.
We will then close the gathering with an accessible yoga practice led by a trusted local yoga instructor, giving participants an opportunity to intentionally engage with the practice after learning more about its history and context.
Through both conversation and practice, we hope to break down stigmas and misconceptions about yoga—what it is, what it is not, and how it may support an individual's physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual well-being.
Most importantly, this is an opportunity to ask questions, learn from one another, and explore whether yoga can be a meaningful part of our own healing and wellness journeys.

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Richmond.

description: Jaane Pehchaane Anjane A Musical Play By Anupam Kher & Swaroop Sampat in Houston Jaane Pehchaane Anjane – A Musical Play by Anupam Kher & Swaroop Sampat in Houston Experience an unforgettable evening of theatre, music, and heartfelt storytelling with Jaane Pehchaane Anjane, a critically acclaimed Hindi musical play starring legendary actors Anupam Kher and Swaroop Sampat. Written and directed by acclaimed filmmaker Gajendra Ahire, with soul-stirring music by Anu Malik, this extraordinary production brings together powerful performances, memorable melodies, and an emotionally rich narrative. Set in a contemporary neighborhood, the story follows the lives of ordinary people whose hidden emotions, personal struggles, and search for companionship reveal that even familiar faces can remain strangers at heart. Through humor, music, and deeply moving moments, the play explores themes of loneliness, relationships, hope, identity, and human connection that resonate with audiences of all generations.

Leave work behind and get out to the beach on Friday night! It's the most beautiful, life-giving place to be at the end of your week ✨

About this Event

Join us for this Friday night sunset edition of our signature class groove yoga & dance class.

We'll spend the first 45 minutes moving and breathing with the ocean, soulful beats, and our sweet community, and then transition to a 30 minute dance party at the ocean's edge 🌊✨

This all-levels creative vinyasa flow class moves through postures at a steady pace, cultivating a sense of connection within ourselves and our surroundings. The intention of this class is to create ease, joy, health and healing in heart, body and mind. With each class you will build strength, suppleness and flexibility.

Near the end of our practice we head down to the water’s edge for a dance party, inviting a playful and freeing aspect to your practice. You can expect an exquisitely curated soundtrack of music— from fun and familiar, booty-shakin beats, to soft, soulful tracks meant to soothe the heart, to other worldly sounds that are sure to inspire ecstatic expression— informing an ever-changing tapestry of movement and emotion.

With views of the Golden Gate Bridge, resting your eyes on the waves as you practice, and watching birds soar above, curated music and our incredible community - it’s truly a magical experience to be immersed in.

About your teacher, Kirin:
My classes are rhythmic, soulful, liberating, and powerful. Connect breath, body, and soul with the miraculous, ecstatic, and powerful elements of nature and awaken to the wonder and awe of being alive and embodied! My hope is that our time together will remind you of the medicine that is gratitude, and leave you feeling empowered, wrapped in self-love, & vibrating at your highest frequency.

title: Rest & Renewal Gentle Yoga with Nicole Cronin and Sound by Lucia Lilikoi
description: Ancient cradle songs for a world that needs to rest — woven through an evening of gentle movement, breath, and live music. Come as you are.
long_description:
Ancient cradle songs for a world that needs to rest — woven through an evening of gentle movement, breath, and live music. Come as you are.

About this Event

Rest & Renewal
An evening of movement & sound
Ancient cradle songs for a world that needs to rest — woven through an evening of gentle movement, breath, and live music.
For one night, The Pad Studios becomes a place to set things down. Nicole Cronin guides a slow, accessible practice built around breath and release — nothing to push through, nothing to achieve. Alongside her, Lucía Lilikoi sings live: lullabies drawn from old traditions, sung in the dark, carrying the same intention they always have. To quiet. To soften. To let someone else hold the night for a while.
No experience is needed, and no part of this asks anything of you. Arrive tired. Arrive tender. Move as much or as little as you like — some people will follow every cue, some will lie down and simply listen. Both are the practice.
What to expect
· Gentle, all-levels yoga — slow pacing, long holds, plenty of support
· Live voice and instruments throughout, played in the room with you
· A closing rest held in song
Bring a mat, and anything that makes the floor feel kind — a blanket, a cushion, warm layers. Space is limited, so early booking is encouraged.
Come as you are. Leave restored.
Nicole Cronin — yoga teacher & guide
Lucía Lilikoi — singer, composer & sound practitioner

Moravian is kicking things off with a BLUE OUT, so throw on some blue and join us for a morning of tailgating, food, drinks and good company before we head into the game.

title: Working with Mind: The Fifty-One Mental Factors of Yogacara Buddhism
description:
"Mind is the forerunner of all things," says the Dhammapada. "The triple world is only mind," says the Avatamsaka Sutra. "If the mind is pure, the Buddha-land is pure," says the Vimalakirti. The centrality of mind — knowing it, working with it, and (in the language of the sutras) purifying it — runs through Buddhist practice from the earliest teachings forward.

long_description:
"Mind is the forerunner of all things," says the Dhammapada. "The triple world is only mind," says the Avatamsaka Sutra. "If the mind is pure, the Buddha-land is pure," says the Vimalakirti. The centrality of mind — knowing it, working with it, and (in the language of the sutras) purifying it — runs through Buddhist practice from the earliest teachings forward.

The Yogacara school of Mahayana Buddhism took this centrality of mind as its foundational principle — our world, as we experience it, is a construction of mind — and developed from it a detailed map: fifty-one mental factors that arise, combine, and shape moment-to-moment experience. Some are wholesome, some afflictive, some ethically neutral. Learning to recognize them as they happen, in one's own experience, is a practical, hands-on approach to what the sutras call the work of purifying mind.

Over five sessions, Gareth will provide context for the Yogacara tradition — which shaped much of later East Asian Buddhism, including Chan and Zen — and work through the fifty-one factors, including contemporary additions relevant to twenty-first-century life. For each, we'll look at how it shows up, how it affects mind and body, how it hijacks our attention when it does, and what antidotes and practices help restore equanimity.

Reference materials are provided as aids for ongoing practice, and each session includes guided meditation alongside teaching and discussion.
This series is a good fit for practitioners with some meditation experience who want to bring more precision and skill to working with their own minds. No prior study of Yogacara or the Abhidharma is required.
Gareth Young, Red Clay Sangha's Guiding Teacher, leads the retreat.

Gareth holds teaching authority in the Vipassana tradition, and has trained extensively in Chan and Zen; his teaching integrates the three, with the Pali suttas and Chan sources as its primary ground.

title: The House at Otowi Bridge by Peggy Pond Church
description:
*Winner of the Richard Harris Award for Publishing Excellence from the New Mexico Book Association*

This is the story of Edith Warner, who lived for more than twenty years as a neighbor to the Indians of San Ildefonso Pueblo, near Los Alamos, New Mexico. She was a remarkable woman, a friend to everyone who knew her, from her Indian companion Tilano, who was an elder of San Ildefonso, to Niels Bohr, Robert Oppenheimer, and the other atomic scientists who worked at Los Alamos during World War II.

long_description:
The ECK Light and Sound service consists of an inspirational reading, singing the HU Song, followed by a discussion. This month's topic is:
“What is Life Teaching me Now? -
Recognizing the lessons (opportunities) in every moment”
Into The GOD Current
“Sometimes we clutch a goal or desire, thinking, I gotta make this thing happen
One secret that I discovered after clutching a lot is to lovingly turn these intentions over to the Holy Spirit, to Divine Spirit. Put them into the God Current, let go, and see what happens. There’s an extra-special dimen-sion outside cause and effect. It can alter your line of destiny.” Sri Doug Kunin, A New Year of Spiritual Growth, “Temple of ECK, Light and Sound Service, Chanhassen, MN. 01-2026

SACRED SOUND ANCIENT MANTRA
HU is an ancient name for God. It has been used for thousands of years as a prayer and sacred chant to attune oneself to the presence of God. Millions of people around the world have experienced the joy of HU.

In many spiritual traditions, sound plays an important part in uplifting the individual. HU is a key to open your heart to God’s loving presence in your life.

Anyone can benefit from this song of spiritual love regardless of age, background, or religion. The HU song closes with a few moments of quiet contemplation followed by an open discussion of the morning’s topic. All are welcome! For more info call- 267-347-4165

long_description:
Art of Rest is a quarterly mindfulness program in partnership with The Livelihoods LLC (formerly Replenish Well & The Yoga Carriage).

With the rush of the busy world, how do we infuse rest into our everyday life?

Join us for an intentional, inspired, and communal 2-hour rest curation. We invite in spaciousness, curiosity, and calm. We will explore ways to create equanimity in the body, mind, and heart through the energy giving power of rest. Art of Rest is an invitation to calm the central nervous system and re-awaken you to present moment awareness.

Rest requires comfort. Wear comfortable layers of clothing for temperature regulation. Please bring a yoga mat, blanket and one or two pillows. We recommend having a journal, pencil, and water bottle.

Tickets are $25 for members, $30 for nonmembers. Registration is encouraged.

long_description:
Celebrate Gujarati literature, poetry and sugam Sangeet in an evening with Dr. Vinod Joshi and Dr. Raeesh Maniyar. book your seats at http://Gujarati.Life/Events

ગુજરાતી સાહિત્ય સંધ્યા - ડૉ. વિનોદ જોશી અને રવિશ મણિયાર

DFW Gujarati Samaj આપને એક વિશિષ્ટ સાહિત્યિક સાંજમાં હાર્દિક આમંત્રિત કરે છે, જેમાં ગુજરાતી સાહિત્યના અગ્રણી કવિ, વિવેચક અને સાહિત્યકાર ડૉ. વિનોદ જોશી અને રવિશ મણિયાર આપણી વચ્ચે ઉપસ્થિત રહેશે.

ગુજરાતી કાવ્ય, ગીત, ગઝલ અને સાહિત્યની સમૃદ્ધ પરંપરાને જીવંત બનાવતા ડૉ. વિનોદ જોશીએ ચાર દાયકાથી વધુ સમય સુધી ગુજરાતી ભાષા અને સાહિત્યને અનન્ય યોગદાન આપ્યું છે. તેઓ અનેક પ્રતિષ્ઠિત સાહિત્યિક સન્માનોથી નવાજાયેલા છે અને તેમની કૃતિઓ ગુજરાત તથા વિશ્વભરના ગુજરાતી વાચકોમાં અત્યંત લોકપ્રિય છે. આ કાર્યક્રમ દરમિયાન ડૉ. વિનોદ જોશી તેમની સાહિત્યિક સફર, સર્જનાત્મક અનુભવો, કાવ્યપાઠ અને ગુજરાતી ભાષાના ભવિષ્ય વિષે પોતાના વિચારો રજૂ કરશે. સાહિત્યપ્રેમીઓ માટે આ એક અનોખી તક છે જ્યાં તેઓ એક મહાન સર્જક સાથે સીધો સંવાદ કરી શકશે અને ગુજરાતી સાહિત્યની ગહનતા તથા સૌંદર્યનો આસ્વાદ માણી શકશે.

રવિશ માણિયાર ગુજરાતી સાહિત્યના જાણીતા કવિ, લેખક અને હાસ્યરસના અદભુત સર્જક છે.
તેમની કવિતામાં લાગણી, કલ્પના, જીવનદર્શન અને હાસ્યનો સુંદર સંગમ જોવા મળે છે.

શબ્દોને સહજતા અને સંવેદનાથી રજૂ કરવાની તેમની આગવી શૈલી શ્રોતાઓને તરત જ પોતાની સાથે જોડી લે છે.
કવિ હોવા ઉપરાંત તેઓ ઉત્તમ વક્તા અને મનોરંજક કલાકાર તરીકે પણ પ્રેક્ષકોના દિલમાં ખાસ સ્થાન ધરાવે છે.
તેમની હાજરી કોઈપણ સાહિત્યિક કે સાંસ્કૃતિક કાર્યક્રમને શબ્દો, સ્મિત અને લાગણીઓથી યાદગાર બનાવી દે છે.

આવો, શબ્દોની સુગંધ અને સાહિત્યની સરસ્વતી સાથે એક યાદગાર સાંજનો ભાગ બનો.

long_description:
Get ready to have your mind blown multiple times over turquoise waters, frothing waterfalls, badass mountain summits, and medieval towns. Croatia will turn anyone into an annoying romantic. Book your week-long women’s multi-sport adventure tour featuring hiking, e-biking, mountain-summiting, sea kayaking, snorkeling, and plenty of Adriatic Sea swimming. You’ll explore ancient cities tripping through architectural history from ancient Roman, Venetian Gothic, Romanesque, and Medieval. Cycle through stupid-pretty Istrian Peninsula hilltop towns. Bust your booties through Plitvice Lakes and Paklenica National Parks. Climb a freaking Via Ferrata to summit Bojin Kuk. And float through the 80+ islands that make up Kornati National Park. BRB we need to pick our jaw up from off the ground.

**EXPLORE ZAGREB, CROATIA’S CAPITAL CITY**

You and your Explorer Chick entourage will geek over all the architecture porn – from medieval stone gates to Gothic cathedrals. We’ll visit all the “musts” and gather for a welcome dinner in the Old Town. Did you just change your Insta handle to Croatia_Cutie? We are obsessed with you!

**E-BIKES, WINE, AND TRUFFLES IN THE ISTRIAN COUNTRYSIDE**

What could be better than seeing tiny cutie towns? TASTING the wares of those tiny cutie towns! We’ll cruise the Parenzana trail on our E-Bikes, stopping in Grožnjan, Oprtalj, and Motovun for coffee, olive oil tastings, and a spectacular lunch. By evening, we’ll cycle to the top of Motovun for a stunning gargoyle view of the Adriatic cities. You won’t leave Istria without loading your bike down with bottles of wine and a tummy full of truffles.

**HIKE PLITVICE LAKES AND PAKLENICA NATIONAL PARKS**

You’re gonna see the kind of natural beauty that shows up in the screensavers of Apple products. The Instagram world is stark raving mad over Plitvice Lakes because of its unique system of lakes and waterfalls. A rock climbing and hiking paradise awaits you in Paklenica National Park with views of the Adriat

long_description:
SOMATIC RELEASE *SOUND BATH* blends therapeutic sound, vibration, and gentle body-based awareness practices to calm the nervous system and release stored physical, mental, and emotional tension. 

This monthly practice opens with PMR (Progressive Muscle Relaxation) techniques to ease the body before surrendering to the resonance of crystal singing bowls, harp, hypnotic percussion, and soft guidance into a state of deep relaxation. Somatic sound therapy can help you unblock survival energies — such as fight, flight, or freeze responses — that became trapped during overwhelming or traumatic events.

Whether you’re seeking rest, clarity, nervous system support, or simply a moment to reconnect with yourself, this workshop offers a safe and nurturing space. All bodies and all identities are welcome — whether you’re new to sound baths or returning to venture deeper.

ABOUT THE INSTRUCTOR: Charlie Sebastian Short is a certified sound practitioner, musician, and caregiver based in Portland. His work draws from the Quantum Sound Method, classical music training, and years of supporting both humans and animals with patience and care. He approaches sound healing as nervous system support, using harmonious instruments to encourage rest, calm, and emotional ease. As a mixed-race, LGBTQIA+, and neurodivergent practitioner, Charlie creates an inclusive space where all bodies and identities can access comfort and relaxation.

SOMATIC RELEASE SOUND BATH *Sliding-Scale* with Charlie Sebastian Short @charliesoundpractice @ Lighthouse Community Yoga PDX / EVERY FIRST SUNDAY EVENING / 5:00-6:00 PM

long_description:
Take time to slow down and pause in stillness with this yin style class. This is a meditative practice that aids flexibility and longevity by targeting the fascia, joints and ligaments. Open the body and the mind through gentle long-held postures. Each pose will be held between 3-7 minutes with light, small movements offered in between. Please be on time. No refunds for late arrivals or no shows.

Briiohn has been teaching for over 3 years as a RYT-200 with additional training in Yin and Somatic Gentle Yoga. Her style is calming and meditative with a focus on finding the support each student needs in order to relax.

Originally drawn to Ashtanga yoga, Briiohn learned how to push the body to its limits and unlock possibilities of asana. Then after being introduced to the many benefits of Yin yoga, she learned how to push the limits of the mind while letting the body rest. When the body is still sometimes the mind begins to race. With a consistent practice, Briiohn’s classes will guide you to notice the patterns in the thoughts through mindfulness. Briiohn offers private yoga sessions to deepen your practice with classes curated just for you.

long_description:
“The Master Mind principle: Two or more people actively engaged in the pursuit of a definite purpose with a positive mental attitude, constitute an unbeatable force.”

— Napoleon Hill

Empire Builders Mastermind (Growth Strategies) group is hosted by International Success Coach Misty Rose Gold. We come together in the true mastermind fashion talked about in Napoleon Hill's book Think And Grow Rich. We support each other through challenges that come as you build your empire. Knowing that you are not alone is half the battle. When challenges arise we use our collective knowledge to create a solution. The commitment and accountability of the group is a game changer for those looking for a unique and proven experience to grow their empire.

If you have a skill set that can add value to our mastermind, come and visit us. We would love to meet you! One visit allowed per person. If you love us we will take a vote. If voted in you will become a valuable member of a game changing group.

If you are looking for a traditional networking group please move on. Do we network in the mastermind group? Yes, it naturally takes place if someone is in need of something specific. Otherwise we are there to learn, grow, support, and crush our goals.

Each week, Misty presents a topic that covers the fundamentals of building a successful empire with integrity. Such as, "What gives your empire credibility?" If you are messy and run over people to get ahead don't bother. We will vote you out anyway. Integrity is the core value of our mastermind group. If you believe in doing business with integrity bring it! Come check us out. Your next level awaits!

To learn more about Misty, please visit her website at www.mistyrosegold.com. You can listen to Wealthy Mind podcast on all platforms. It'll give you an instant boost of motivation!

long_description:
Come party with the Living With Harmony peeps as we celebrate our awesome community and the planet at our PLANET-Based Party in Denver. Monday, Sept 7.

This event will be hosted by [Native Foods ](https://nativefoods.com/glendale)

The lectures are FREE to attend. There is plenty of party space, but come early to find a good seat, to meet and greet, to order food and to socialize. Check out the Living With Harmony booth and meet Andrea Rose, our co-founder.
Visit our sponsored non-profit, [Bleating Hearts,](https://www.bleatingheartssanctuary.org/) a local animal sanctuary that provides lifelong refuge for a lucky few that have escaped the fate of most animals bred and raised for food. Pick up some vegan educational materials too.

He works with Microsoft, partners, and customers to educate their teams on that content. He is a former Power BI and Power Platform technical specialist from Microsoft, analytics service owner, and Dynamics 365 CE technical architect.

Join us for a heart-centered journaling experience designed to help you slow down, reconnect with yourself, and create space for meaningful reflection.
Each workshop centers around a unique theme and begins with a guided meditation to calm the nervous system, quiet the mind, and encourage deeper self-awareness. From there, participants will work through journaling prompts, reflection exercises, and opportunities for creative self-expression.

Enjoy a cup of tea as we gather in a supportive and welcoming space to reflect on where we are, release what is no longer serving us, and renew our intentions moving forward. Together, we’ll explore the power of the written word as a tool for self-discovery, healing, and manifestation. Writing can help us gain clarity, set intentions, process emotions, and remember the power we hold when we consciously write our desires into existence.

Participants are welcome to bring their favorite journal, pen, and mug to personalize the experience. Extra pens and cups will also be available.

Whether you’re brand new to journaling or have kept journals for years, this experience is designed to help you cultivate clarity, creativity, self-trust, and connection, without the pressure of writing perfectly.

Many beauty professionals are talented at their craft, but were never taught how to properly think through pricing. As a result, many professionals price their services by copying competitors, guessing, or charging what feels comfortable instead of using a strategy that supports their goals.

During this session, we’ll discuss:

Common pricing strategies used in the beauty industry
How pricing affects your income and profit
Why undercharging can limit business growth
How customers may view different price points
How to choose a pricing strategy that supports your business goals
How RS Beauty Pricing can help you better understand your numbers

This is an educational meeting created to help beauty professionals gain more confidence with pricing decisions. Whether you are a student, new professional, or already working in the industry, this session will help you think more clearly about how your pricing strategy affects your business.

Come ready to learn, ask questions, and connect with other beauty professionals who want to grow and price their services with more confidence.

long_description:
ABNG\*\*: Where Relationships Build Revenue\*\*

Tired of "boring" networking and being sold to? We are too. ABNG, we believe referrals happen when people know, like, and trust each other. We aren't here to swap business cards, we’re here to build a "referral-generating engine" with friends and power partners.

### **Join Us at The Sportsbook - Highlands Ranch**

We meet in person and would love to have you at the table!

**Please RSVP early** to ensure we have a seat saved for you, as space is limited.

**The Game Plan:**

* **11:45 AM \| Arrive & Order:** Please arrive early to grab your lunch, snag a seat, and enjoy some low-pressure conversation. We start promptly at **12:00 PM** to ensure everyone can get back to their day on time.
* **The 45-Second Spotlight:** Share your "Why" and your story. Tell us who you are and what you do, but lead with your purpose rather than a sales pitch.
* **Peer-to-Peer Learning:** We crowd-source our education. Each week, a member requested topic for a 10-minute roundtable "deep dive" leads to great conversation and ideas.
* **The Referral Exchange:** We pass cards, announce upcoming workshops, and share our weekly wins. We want to hear what’s working for you and celebrate the referrals that have turned into business.

### **A Note on Our Culture**

This is a relationship first group. If you’re looking to "swoop in," collect cards, and then cold call everyone on the list, we probably aren’t the right fit. We focus on building bonds during lunch and encourage **1-on-1 meetings** outside of our weekly gatherings to truly strengthen our partnerships.
**We’re excited to connect and grow with you.**

**See you at The Sportsbook - Highlands Ranch!**

description: A relaxed, welcoming evening for people who value Asian and Indian culture, good conversation, genuine connection,
long_description:
A relaxed, welcoming evening for people who value Asian and Indian culture, good conversation, genuine connection,

About this Event

Orlando is full of people. Yet finding people you genuinely connect with can still be surprisingly difficult.
Asian & Indian Social Night is an evening designed to make that feel a little easier.
A relaxed setting. Interesting people. Good conversation. And a community that values warmth, loyalty, friendship, family, and staying connected.
The evening brings together people from across Orlando's South Asian, East Asian, and Southeast Asian communities, including Indian, Nepali, Bhutanese, Bangladeshi, Chinese, Korean, Taiwanese, Japanese, Thai, Indonesian, Filipino, Vietnamese, Malaysian, Singaporean, and many other backgrounds.
But you do not have to come from one of these cultures to join us.
This evening is open to anyone who appreciates the warmth, hospitality, and sense of community these cultures are known for.
The atmosphere is meant to feel social without feeling forced. Welcoming without being loud. Comfortable enough to attend with friends, and easy enough to attend on your own.
This is not a formal networking event.
It is not a high-pressure singles event.
It is simply a good room filled with people worth meeting.
You may meet someone who understands your culture without an explanation. Someone whose background is completely different from yours. A new friend for dinner next weekend. A new group to explore Orlando with. Perhaps someone who becomes more important in your life over time.
There is no expectation beyond showing up, being open, and enjoying the evening.
Come with friends or come on your own. Both are completely normal here.
Complimentary admission.
Sometimes a new community begins with one conversation.

Reserve your free ticket, then share this invitation with someone who could use a little more friendship—and a little more magic.
Your next favorite friendship may begin with one simple hello. ✨

Event DetailsDa

classical yoga asana followed by a traditional Himalayan sound bath, led by Chirag Raju and Rebecca Dunaway.

About this Event

In Sanskrit, Nada (नाद) translates to "sound" or "vibration". Derived from the root nad (meaning "to flow"), it refers to the primal, cosmic vibration believed to be the origin of the universe. This concept forms the foundation of Nada Yoga, the ancient practice of achieving spiritual union through deep listening and sound.

Join us for a deep, relaxing rest in your inner vibration. Miraculaous healing, deep meditation and unexpected insight in the form and formless - are all expected.

In-Person Documentary Night is usually held on every 2nd Friday of the month. This event was designed to give people the chance to discuss interesting ideas and topics explored in the documentaries that we have chosen as a group to watch. This month we voted to watch the the documentary, **[1971](https://documentarynight.wordpress.com/2026/08/15/1971/).** 1971 reveals the stories of the burglars who broke into a small FBI office in Media, Pennsylvania, took every file, and shared them with the public.

**[>>Click here to watch the film trailer<<](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XSzhvdbQesg)**

**We will start the film PROMPTLY AT 7:10 PM.**

For the event we will meet together in the sanctuary at Northwest Unitarian Universalist Congregation, where we will watch the film together. Then we will participate in multiple rounds of small group discussions with a different groups for each round. This gives you the opportunity to meet new people and hear a variety of perspectives throughout the night. We will end by deciding what to watch next month. **This is a Voting Night where we brainstorm and decide as a group what we will watch the following month, so please come with a recommendation ready!**

**Feel free to bring your dinner! Decaf and caffeinated tea will be provided. We will also be having potluck style snacks!** So you are welcome to bring food to share with others, whether homemade or store-bought. Please bring foods that won't be distracting for others during the film or the discussion. description:
Introduced by Lalitha Gopalan, associate professor of Cinema Studies at the University of Texas at Austin and author of the book Kaagaz Ke Phool (Paper Flowers): BFI Film Classics. Buy her book here in person before the show starts!

The first Indian film shot in CinemaScope, Guru Dutt’s masterpiece
long_description:
Introduced by Lalitha Gopalan, associate professor of Cinema Studies at the University of Texas at Austin and author of the book Kaagaz Ke Phool (Paper Flowers): BFI Film Classics. Buy her book here in person before the show starts!

The first Indian film shot in CinemaScope, Guru Dutt’s masterpiece follows the successful filmmaker Suresh Sinha (played by Dutt) as rumors of his affair with actress Shanti (Waheeda Rehman) lead him to lose his family, descend into alcoholism, and ultimately retreat from the film industry. Initially a critical and commercial failure, the film is now revered for its technical prowess, stunning chiaroscuro images, beautiful songs, and heartbreaking, self-reflexive narrative.

Shown in a digital restoration by the National Film Archive of India.

Cost: free, register in advance recommended.

Director: Guru Dutt. Country: India. Released: 1959. Length: 148 min. Format: DCP, B&W. Language: Hindi with English subtitles.

Kaagaz Still: Courtesy of the National Film Archive of India

Book Cover: Courtesy of the British Film Institute

title: Yoga Sutras with Kate Holcombe
description: Join Yoga Philosophy and Sanskrit scholar, Kate Holcombe, for an inspiring and insightful workshop on the  history of Yoga philosophy.
long_description:
Join Yoga Philosophy and Sanskrit scholar, Kate Holcombe, for an inspiring and insightful workshop on the history of Yoga philosophy.

About this Event

Join Yoga Philosophy and Sanskrit scholar, Kate Holcombe, for an inspiring and insightful workshop on the history of Yoga philosophy and specifically, the richness of the Yoga Sutras of Patanjali. In this workshop we will primarily focus on the history of yoga philosophy as a means to help us reduce our experience of suffering and feel better in everyday life. We will also explore the differences between yoga philosophy and Hinduism, and how these two distinct philosophical systems have become confused and enmeshed over time.
It is appropriate for yoga enthusiasts of all levels and will include both lecture and discussion.

Bio:
Kate is founder and director of Healing Yoga Foundation, a non-profit project of Commonweal dedicated to supporting and empowering individuals in their own health, healing, and personal development through yoga, regardless of ability, background, experience, or financial means.

Kate began her yoga education in 1991 as a student of T.K.V. Desikachar in Chennai, India, returning many times for extended periods of intensive one-on-one study until his death in 2016. In conjunction with her yoga studies, Kate has studied Sanskrit at UC Berkeley, and the Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute (Madras Sanskrit College) in Chennai, India.

Kate leads workshops and trainings for students around the country and is a popular writer, lecturer, teacher trainer, and yoga therapist. She is known for her practical, straightforward approach, her clarity and authenticity, and her relatable examples.
