long_description:
STOP RUNNING! WHAT ARE YOU AVOIDING? SHOW UP!

Weird times we're living in, no wonder most of us are living numb.... scrolling mindlessly on our phones, spending money on things we don't need, and running around chasing our tails getting nowhere fast.

This 200 Hour Foundational Yoga Teacher Training program is an emergency cord, a lifeline for you to stop letting the noise distract you, to wake up and self-regulate, so that you can integrate this very real and, sometimes, very heavy experience of being an eternal spirit soul experiencing this crazy material world from inside a very temporary physical body. 

In this program, we train your attention, your nervous system, and your voice so that you can truly connect to the truth of what matters most and meet your life with authenticity. You'll learn everything you need to know to be an incredible yoga teacher, but more importantly, you'll learn how to focus, breathe, and feel, to choose your lived experience with intention. 

You’ll leave with:

-Self-trust in your unshakable ability to deal with real-world stress

-Aligned action over old patterns, negative self-talk, self-deprecating habits, and avoidance

-Courage to be happy, feel deeply, connect with others, and stay present no matter what

Skills that exceed Yoga Alliance standards for 200-Hour yoga teacher training programs: 

Asana (Postures): A deep dive into the foundational poses, including alignments, modifications, benefits, and how to sequence them into flows or sets.

Pranayama (Breathing): Various techniques like Nadi Shodhana, Ujjayi, Kapalbhati, Bhramari, and their effects on prana (life force).

Anatomy & Physiology: Understand the myofascial structures of the body, how each part relates to the other parts, and how functional movement works in the field of gravity. Learn injury prevention and how yoga impacts the body.

title: 50-Hr Yin Yoga Immersion & Teacher Training
description: 50-Hr Yin Yoga Immersion & Teacher Training
long_description:
Deepen your understanding of Yin Yoga through anatomy, fascia, meridian theory, mindfulness, meditation, and skillful teaching practices.

About this Event

PROGRAM OVERVIEWThis 50-hour Yin Yoga Immersion & Teacher Training offers a deep exploration of Yin Yoga as both a contemplative practice and a skillful teaching methodology. Rooted in the principles of stillness, time, and mindful awareness, this training explores how Yin Yoga supports physical health, emotional balance, and energetic harmony.

Through guided practice, lecture, discussion, and teaching practicum, participants will study the foundations of Yin Yoga, the biomechanics of fascia and connective tissue, Chinese meridian theory, and the role of mindfulness and meditation within the practice. You will learn how Yin postures influence the body’s connective tissues, stimulate energetic pathways, and create space for deeper self-awareness.

Beyond the physical practice, Yin Yoga invites us to slow down and listen inwardly. By spending time in stillness, we begin to observe the patterns of body and mind that shape our experience. Over time, the practice becomes a mirror that reveals both habitual tension and an untapped inner sanctuary.

Participants will also develop the practical skills needed to teach Yin Yoga with confidence and integrity — including sequencing, pose architecture, intelligent use of props, and the language of mindfulness that helps students safely explore their edge.

This training is open to yoga teachers, dedicated practitioners, and wellness professionals who wish to deepen their understanding of Yin Yoga, develop a sustainable personal practice, and learn how to guide others toward the restorative and transformative benefits of this practice.

Many participants join not only to learn how to teach Yin Yoga, but also to deepen their own relationship with stillness, self-awareness, and nervous system balance. This training offers space for both professional development and personal ex

description:
**Benvenuti in Italia**
This is the trip to Italy that you’ve always dreamed of – the Dolomites, wine, epic sunrises, lakes, and food. Call the craggy Italian Alps sirens home as you explore jaw-dropping trails and impossibly cute mountain villages on this 8-day women’s hiking adventure in northern Italy.

long_description:
**Benvenuti in Italia**
This is the trip to Italy that you’ve always dreamed of – the Dolomites, wine, epic sunrises, lakes, and food. Call the craggy Italian Alps sirens home as you explore jaw-dropping trails and impossibly cute mountain villages on this 8-day women’s hiking adventure in northern Italy.

We’ll meet in Venice before heading out for views of stunning glaciers, dramatic spires, and towering vistas complete with secret WWI tunnels. Our debut hike to Tre Cime di Lavaredo is a UNESCO World Heritage Site (aka photogenic panty-dropper) where we’ll stay in a luxurious mountain “hut” and eat our body weight in alpine cooking.

You’ll learn how to traverse via-ferrata style as we sling our powerful bodies across vertical rock walls to climb Monte Paterno. From there, we’ll shuttle to the iconic trailheads of Cinque Torri and Puez-Odle Nature Park, where we’ll spend the night sleeping in an authentic family-run hut high up in the mountains where even Starbucks can’t reach.

Also, no, you don’t have to hulk your beefy Samsonite up the mountains. Throughout your adventure, you only have to sherpa your daypack. We’ll shuttle your main luggage from hut to hotel since you’ll have your hands full moonlighting for National Geographic.

We’ll have down time in villages that can only be described as bucolic AF––including Cortina d’Ampezzo, Corvara, Ortisei, and the stunning South Tyrol wine region which we’ll explore by e-bike. Amidst all the hiking, including an epic sunrise climb, we’ll build in time for slow mornings and plenty of relaxing. There’ll be wine tastings, an alpine spa visit, a hands-on Italian cooking class, and epic sailing on Lake Garda. Did you just become the most interesting woman on the school board? Yes, you did!

**See the website for full itinerary, details and to book.**

title: I Meditate CLE
description:
Let's Meditate CLE! Come to Cleveland's 7th annual mass meditation and create a collective consciousness of ONE mind!  When like-minded people gather with elevated intentions, it will create an energetic ripple that can benefit for all beings. 
Join several of Cleveland's yoga and meditation leaders
long_description:
Let's Meditate CLE! Come to Cleveland's 7th annual mass meditation and create a collective consciousness of ONE mind! When like-minded people gather with elevated intentions, it will create an energetic ripple that can benefit for all beings. 

Join several of Cleveland's yoga and meditation leaders to help raise the vibrations in our city and send out healing energy to Mother Earth.

During these times of division, we must journey from the mind into the heart for the greater good of all life on the planet and for the generations to come. In every wisdom tradition, meditation hasn’t been just a way to seek inner knowledge. It has the potential to transform the world. 

Research on the power of group meditation has been ongoing for decades, and the results have shown extremely positive social, political and economic results correlated to synchronized group meditations.

Experienced meditation teachers will lead you in techniques such as Mindfulness, Breathwork, Loving Kindness Meditation (Metta) and more. The event will conclude with a sound bath and kirtan (call and response community chanting).

Our group sing-along will give you a chance to share your voice as we chant peace mantras: Lokah Samastha Sukhino Bhavantu (May All Beings Be Happy & Free) and Om Shanti. 

This event is hosted and founded by Denys Morgan and with the support of her other volunteer co-facilitators. You can DM Denys on Instagram @IMeditateCLE if have questions or would like to volunteer.

This year, we will feature a heartfelt tribute to the remarkable life of former presenter Vonita Burke. A representative from My Village Yoga will guide a special meditation in her memory.

We will meet on the large grassy space in front of the FREE STAMP at Willard Park on the corner of E. 9th St and Lakeside. 

In case of inclement weather, the event will be rescheduled. Please check this event page or our Instagram page 1 hour before the event for confirmation if the weather looks untenable.

long_description:
You're invited to the best play date of the year.
Who's inviting you? Your inner child. And they want you to know; it's been too long since the two of you spent time together doing things that bring you joy and wonder.

Senseful Wellness is pairing up with Ayla Claypool for an afternoon that is equal parts intentional and delightfully unserious. A three-hour hang designed for the part of you that still knows how to play.
Ayla will guide everyone through a series of games using techniques from physical theatre theorist Jacques Lecoq in order to open our spacial and emotional awareness and take steps toward transformation. Exploratory and silly, serious play asks everyone the question of what does it mean to move like a kid again. To find the joy.

Vi will open and close the Playshop calling in your inner child and creating the container for them to actually show up and stay a while.

Jenn will move everyone through an Inner Child Vinyasa Flow, designed for all bodies and all ages.
Together we have created an afternoon that gives your inner child permission to flourish, and reminds everyone that we are all still big kids at heart.

Come play with us.

Product management has always been a job of many disciplines stitched together. Remember the old venn diagram of UX/Tech/Business with You are here? (see above) The role has always been part strategy, part research, part design sense, part technical fluency, part operations. Historically, n
long_description:
**Everyone's a LIttle Bit PM Now**
We have a very special **AI & Product Colorado** edition lined up for **Colorado Startup Week**. Kick off the week in style by joining us at Code Talent on Monday, Sept 14.

Product management has always been a job of many disciplines stitched together. Remember the old venn diagram of UX/Tech/Business with You are here? (see above) The role has always been part strategy, part research, part design sense, part technical fluency, part operations. Historically, no one person could do all of it well; teams split the work across specialists, and PMs learned to lean on the ones around them.

AI is blurring the lines between that division. Research that took a week of interviews and synthesis now takes an afternoon. A PM can prototype a real interface instead of describing one in a doc. Dev, design, and product ops tasks that used to require handoffs are increasingly things one person can just do. The result isn't a new job title — it's a shift in what a single product person is expected to own.

This session digs into that shift from multiple vantage points. We'll talk about which skills are becoming table stakes, which are becoming differentiators, and what this means for how you grow your career or build your team in the next few year.

long_description:
Where: Tivoli Student Union, room 444
When: Monday, Sept. 14th from 12:30-2:00

Are you passionate about healing and wellness but find yourself uneasy when it comes to the financial side of running your business?

Join us for a transformative 90-minute workshop at Colorado Startup Week designed specifically for wellness entrepreneurs who want to build financially sustainable practices without compromising their mission. This session combines practical business fundamentals with a deeper, more conscious relationship to money—because in wellness work, how you relate to money shapes everything from your pricing to your capacity to serve.

We begin by examining your money story. We will spend time exploring our relationship to money and releasing internal money blocks through a guided visualization process.
From there, we move into the practical foundation of knowing your numbers.

We will also explore financing options tailored to service-based wellness businesses, many of which can become cash-flow positive far faster than product-based ventures. From leveraging existing income streams to understanding when and how to seek outside support, you will walk away with a clear-eyed view of your options and how to choose partners — investors, collaborators, even landlords — who genuinely resonate with your mission rather than pull you off course.

This is workshop is about building a healthy, conscious, and sustainable relationship with money, where your financial practices and your healing mission move in the same direction. When you understand your numbers and trust your worth, money becomes less of a source of stress and more of a partner in the impact you are here to make.

long_description:
Our next AITP Lehigh Valley regional meeting will be held on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, in the Trexler Room at DeSales University Center & Bookstore.

This presentation is open for members and non-members, faculty, staff, and students.

ABSTRACT:

**Soft Skills for IT Professionals: Acquiring them with High-Tech Assistance**

Within the last few years, there have been many articles reflecting a big change in industry – soft skills, such as public speaking, teamwork, and leadership, are being sought by IT industry recruiters (1). However, education in computer science and software engineering has traditionally been dominated by the teaching of “hard skills”, such as programming, databases, and math.

In this presentation, Dave Teumim, a certified career coach, soft skills trainer, and former cybersecurity consultant will review the gamut of soft skills that will be needed for different industry roles. Dave will review some new high tech ways of more quickly acquiring soft skills, such as using virtual reality and AI chatbots to help master skills like public speaking and leadership.

1. [The Critical Role of Soft Skills in Software Engineering, Robert Kehinde, 2025](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/critical-role-soft-skills-software-engineering-robert-kehinde-fi0ae/)

ABOUT THE SPEAKER:

Dave Teumim, MSChE, CPCC was a resident of the Lehigh Valley for 31 years. After working as a chemical engineer in New York, he came down to the Lehigh Valley to work for AT&T, Lucent, and Agere Systems in a variety of positions. In 2001, he formed his own consulting firm, Teumim Technical, LLC, specializing in cybersecurity for critical infrastructure. In 2016 he was certified as a career coach, and he has been a frequent speaker at Lehigh Valley Professionals and AITP. He is a member of ATD, the Association for Training and Development, and a longtime member of Toastmasters International.

The meeting will be held on campus in the Trexler Room at the DeSales

organizer: Western History and Biography Meetup Group
long_description:
Andrew Jackson left a permanent imprint upon American politics and the presidency. Within eight years, he melded the amorphous coalition of personal followers who had elected him into the country's most durable and successful political party, an electoral machine whose organization and discipline would serve as a model for all others. At the same time, his controversial conduct in office galvanized opponents to organize the Whig party. The Democratic party was Jackson's child; the national two-party system was his legacy.

Jackson's drive for party organization was spurred by his own difficulties with Congress. Unlike other famously strong Presidents, Jackson defined himself not by enacting a legislative program but by thwarting one. In eight years, Congress passed only one major law, the Indian Removal Act of 1830, at his behest. During this time Jackson vetoed twelve bills, more than his six predecessors combined. One of these was the first "pocket veto" in American history. The Maysville Road and Bank vetoes stood as enduring statements of his political philosophy.

Jackson strengthened himself against Congress by forging direct links with the voters. His official messages, though delivered to Congress, spoke in plain and powerful language to the people at large. Reversing a tradition of executive deference to legislative supremacy, Jackson boldly cast himself as the people's tribune, their sole defender against special interests and their minions in Congress. In other ways, too, Jackson expanded the scope of presidential authority

long_description:
Join the Leh-Ladakh adventure on this trip to India. This trip will make you fall in love with Ladakh with your visit to the land of an incredible blend of mountains, forests, deserts, lakes, rivers, waterfalls, and more in just a week.
Leh Ladakh resembles Tibet in terms of topography and culture and you wouldn’t want to miss its barren lands, High Mountain passes, and unique customs.
Located in the Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh is one of the most popular tourist destinations in India. The region is known for its breathtaking scenery, snow-capped mountains, clean ice lakes, and winding roads. The ancient Buddhist monasteries, largely tucked in the mountains and dating back thousands of years, add to its outstanding beauty.
The journey to one of the most magnificent and dynamic landscapes on the planet, with most of the world’s highest motor-able crossings and the breathtaking splendor of snow-capped mountains, provides you with once in a lifetime experience.

Highlights

Visited Places:

* Delhi
* Leh
* Shanti Stupa, Leh Market, and Leh Palace
* Gurudwara Pathar Sahib
* Indus valley and Zanskar
* Nubra Valley via Khardung La pass
* Diskit monastery
* Pangong Tso Lake
* Thiksey monastery and Shey Palace

Travel Experience:

* A unique fusion of culture and nature with the best experience
* Explore the stunning looking Himalayan peaks
* Explore Diskit monastery, some marvelous lakes like Pangong Tso Lake and Khardung La pass
* Relish the amazing Camel ride and lovely Hundar Valley

title: Yoga for Renewal
venue_name: Jewish Community Center of San Francisco
description: An Iyengar-based yoga class of release, reflection, and return to welcome the Jewish New Year.
long_description:
An Iyengar-based yoga class of release, reflection, and return to welcome the Jewish New Year.

About this Event

Prepare for the Jewish New Year by slowing down, taking a breath, and making space for what's ahead. In this all-levels workshop, Julie Emden, founder of Embodied Jewish Learning, blends Iyengar-inspired yoga with Jewish wisdom to help you reflect, recharge, and reconnect. Through mindful movement and meaningful conversation, you'll let go of the past year, reconnect with yourself, and welcome the new one with greater clarity and intention. 
No prior yoga experience or Hebrew knowledge required. Come as you are, ready to stretch into the new year. 
ABOUT THE FACILITATOR: 
Julie Emden brings over two decades of experience weaving somatic practice with Jewish wisdom traditions. Her facilitation invites participants to connect more deeply with the High Holidays through body, breath, and soul. A graduate of multiple fellowship and certification programs including Dance Midrash, Yoga and Jewish Spirituality, Movement-based Expressive Arts and Iyengar-based Yoga, Julie draws from over 25 years of experience guiding others in embodied explorations of Jewish teachings as a pathway to balance and wholeness.

***Angamardana*** a fitness system rooted in yoga, offers everyone the opportunity to invigorate the body and reach peak physical and mental health. “Angamardana” means gaining complete mastery over the limbs, organs, and other parts of the body. True to its name, this practice revitalizes the body on all levels including the muscles, circulatory system, skeletal structure, nervous system, and the basic energy system.
With exercises carefully selected by Sadhguru to be of universal appeal and application, Angamardana needs no fitness equipment. It uses only the body and can be practiced anywhere, even during travel.

**Regular practice of Angamardana revitalizes the body in many ways:**

* Strengthens the spine, skeletal system, and muscular system
* Builds physical strength, fitness, and tenacity
* Takes years off the body, bringing a sense of lightness and freedom
* Prepares the body for Hatha Yoga.

title: Soul Flow After Dark : Clarity, Balance & Presence
description: Explore the Three Gunas through Mental Yoga, Soul Flow, sound healing, music, and meaningful community connection.
long_description:
Explore the Three Gunas through Mental Yoga, Soul Flow, sound healing, music, and meaningful community connection.

About this Event

Soul Flow After Dark is a Mental Yoga experience that blends community dialogue, Kriya Yoga, sound healing, music, and conscious connection.
This summer series explores the Three Gunas, the ancient yogic forces that influence our thoughts, emotions, behaviors, and relationships. Each evening begins with guided Mental Yoga inquiry and group discussion, helping participants explore the patterns shaping their lives. We then move into an energizing Kriya Yoga practice designed to elevate endorphins, increase awareness, and prepare the mind and body for deeper self study, surrender, and transformation.
The evening concludes with a restorative sound bath followed by music, community, and connection.
July 17

September 18

What to Expect
• Mental Yoga dialogue and self inquiry
• Community discussion and reflection
• Dynamic Kriya Yoga practice
• Sound healing journey
• Music and community gathering
• Cannabis friendly environment
• Opportunities for authentic connection
Important Information
This is an active movement practice. Be prepared to move, sweat, breathe, and engage.
Please bring:
• Yoga mat
• Blanket
• Yoga blocks
• Any additional props you enjoy using
Cannabis Friendly
For participants who choose to partake, this event welcomes conscious and intentional use. In the spirit of Yoga Sutra 4.1, which references Osadhi (plant medicine) as one of several pathways through which altered states and expanded awareness may arise, attendees are invited to explore their experience mindfully and responsibly.
Cannabis consumption is entirely optional and is not required to participate or benefit from the experience.

title: Whispers of Autumn: Yoga & Sound Bath
venue_name: 4 Sawmill Rd, Medford, NJ, United States, New Jersey 08055
description: Whispers of Autumn: Yoga & Sound Bath
long_description:
Join us for another season of Yoga at Cedar Run! All levels are welcomed. This will be a slow vinyasa/yin class. Some flow movement with some deep yin holds! Intentional movement progressing towards strength and healing to make you feel invigorated and relaxed. Breathe in the healing energy of the natural surroundings, heal yourself as you contribute to healing the animals around you.

We will be enjoying our morning yoga in the nature setting of the Pine Barrens. Surrounded by the sounds of nature, the smells of the forest and the morning air, it is sure to calm your mind, body and spirit. This session we will be stretching out in our Wildlife Housing Pavilion as we will take in the sun setting into evening. We will have tea at the nature center as well to help get your body and mind calm, replenished and ready for this session!

Please arrive 10 minutes early at our Nature Center Community Room to use the restroom and check in. If you would like to visit some of our resident wildlife after class we would happy for you to self explore. We would love to introduce you to our friends! Class will start at 6:30pm. 

Please bring your own yoga mat as we do not offer rentals. Props are optional. We have a water refill station for any reusable water bottles. 

Class size of 10. Limited space is available! Grab your spot before we sell out!

Children between the ages of 16-18 must be accompanied by an adult/parent.

No children under 16 may be permitted in the yoga session.

Meet your instructor: Monica Walsh – High Vibrations Association

Monica was first introduced to yoga when her mom brought her to her first class that a friend was teaching at a Synagogue in the late 90s. They attended the class because Monica’s relationship to her newly developing teenage body was not a healthy one. This beautiful, simple, practice opened her eyes to a new path with which to approach the human condition both on and off the mat. Ever since, Monica’s desire for yogic knowledge snowballed

Known as the "Kutch Ni Koyal" (Nightingale of Kutch), Geeta Rabari has captivated audiences worldwide with her soulful voice and energetic stage presence. * This is a state park and paid admission is required

* Ride route will depend on the interest of the group with multiple loops and groups available
* ⚡ e-Bikes are NOT permitted on this ride
* Limited to 15 participants to keep this ride at a reasonable size

Trails and Ales:

* Coed intermediate/advanced ride exploring trails across the Front Range, come explore, meet other riders and stick around for the post ride hang!
* We may split into 2 smaller groups according to desired pace
* No drop ride – we stop at all intersections and wait for all!

Housekeeping:

* Please sign up on Meetup. By signing up for this ride, you agree to our [Waiver](https://www.bouldermountainbike.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/Waiver.pdf).
* Meetup page will be updated with weather conditions - please check prior to the ride for the most up to date information! Event will be cancelled if there is inclement weather. Please arrive 10-15 minutes early for a timely departure! Please arrive at 8:45, ride will roll out at 9:00
* All riders MUST wear a helmet and close-toe shoes, bring water and food, and have a trail-ready bike.
* Riders should carry basic tools: a spare tube, pump, tire lever, chain tool and Allen wrenches.
* All riders ride at their own risk, group leaders take no responsibility for rider safety/injury.

* The Boulder Mountainbike Alliance is a volunteer-run, membership-based, 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. long_description:
Maybe you don't yoga. Or pilates. But you love animals and want to just chill with goats? Join us for a heartwarming and joy-filled experience!

You can arrive anytime between 2-3 PM. 

Similar to the Japanese practice of spending mindful, therapeutic time sitting or walking in nature - Shinrin-yoku, which literally translates to "forest bathing". Developed in the 1980s, the practice involves immersing yourself in the forest atmosphere and engaging with nature through all five of your senses. Welcome to the goat forest!

Our distinguished Key Speakers include the charming goats - Nigerian Dwarf and Mini Silky Fainting ready to share their love and positive energy with all attendees.

Escape the routine and immerse yourself in a therapy session with nature. Whether you prefer to nap or play there's something for everyone. Simply relax in a lawn chair or hammock cuddle with a goat and watch your worries fade away. Feel the magic as time slips by and anxiety melts away in the serene farm setting.

This event is family-friendly so bring your loved ones and make cherished memories together. Please remember to bring your own beverage as our furry friends have a penchant for nibbling on snacks! 

Secure your tickets now through AllEvents and treat yourself to a one-of-a-kind experience that promises to destress and uplift your spirits. Say goodbye to holiday blues and hello to pure joy at "Cuddle with Goats and Puppies and Ducks on the Farm in Rockwall."

Music enthusiasts are cordially invited to the grand spectacle of the "Pure Indian Classical & Semi Classical Ft. Kaushiki Chakraborty Live Concert" held on the 20th of September, 2026. Set in the heart of Washington DC, this melodic evening promises to be a journey through the enchanting realms of Indian Classical and Semi-Classical music. The concert offers a rare chance to witness the live performance of renowned artist Kaushiki Chakraborty, a gem of the Indian music scene. This event is a must-visit for lovers of Hindi music and live concerts.
About Kaushiki Chakraborty: The Reigning Queen of Indian Classical Music
The star of the evening, Kaushiki Chakraborty, is an acclaimed Indian classical vocalist hailing from the illustrious Patiala gharana. Born on 24th October 1980, Kaushiki's musical journey was guided by her father, Ajoy Chakraborty. Her music education at the Sangeet Research Academy has honed her skills, making her one of the leading exponents of Khyals and 'semi-classical' Thumris. She has been recognized globally, bagging the 2005 BBC Radio 3 Awards for World Music in the Asia-Pacific category. Kaushiki's performances with her husband Parthasarathi Desikan are known for their soulful renditions and harmonious chemistry.
Immerse Yourself in Melodies at Washington DC
The concert is set to take place in the bustling city of Washington DC, District of Columbia, United States. The venue offers excellent safety and accessibility, ensuring a comfortable experience for all attendees. Its excellent location in the city allows attendees to explore nearby attractions before or after the concert. Parking facilities are also available at the venue. description: Pink Floyd Concert in the Dark with Award Winning Violinist WAITLIST SHOW
long_description:
Hear the music of Pink Floyd's Dark Side of the Moon at a magical yoga space with Award winning Strings, Piano and Vocals by Dave Madden

About this Event

Step into a world where music and shadows dance together.
Join us for an unforgettable Concert in the Dark, featuring the iconic songs of Pink Floyd’s Dark Side of the Moon—reimagined with award winning violinist Will Taylor, acoustic guitar, cellist Tony Rogers, and piano and vocals by Dave Madden. 🎶
Surrounded by the warm glow of candlelight 🕯️ in a serene yoga studio, this is more than a concert.
It’s an experience.
For over 35 years, thousands of discerning experience-seekers have stepped into the imaginative world of Will Taylor, delighting in performances that blur boundaries, awaken the senses, and reveal music in unforgettable, unexpected ways.
Original music by show creator Will Taylor, inspired by the timeless sounds of Dark Side of the Moon, will be woven throughout the performance, adding a unique layer to this journey.
This is no ordinary show.
It begins and ends in darkness, with live music and a poem or two wrapping around you like a cozy blanket, soothing your soul.
🧘‍♀️ Bring your yoga mat or a pillow, lie back, and let the shadows on the ceiling tell their own story. Chairs will also be available for those who prefer to sit.
Come as you are, and leave transformed.

long_description:
[Blood on the Clocktower (BotC) ](https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/240980/blood-on-the-clocktower)is currently the #1 rated party game on Boardgamegeek.com! We are so pleased that the local community playing BotC at Spielbound has grown such that multiple simultaneous games are being run at each of our BotC meet ups!

In September, the BotC meetup is scheduled for Monday, September 21 from 5:30 - 10:30 PM ... and Spielbound is reserving the \*entire\* Annex (up to 50 attendees\~) for this event!

\* A day pass is required to join this special event ($6 per person on Mondays or current Spielbound member); please check in with the front cafe staff when you arrive.
\* Those who have never played 'Blood on the Clocktower' at Spielbound are welcome to attend this event for free to try it out!
\* Storytellers will be on hand to explain the game rules to novice players, starting at 5:30 PM\~

*More on the game:*
Blood on the Clocktower is a game of murder and mystery, lies and logic, deduction and deception for five-to-twenty courageous players and one devious storyteller.

A social game played in person, seated in a circle, each player receives either a ‘good’ or ‘evil’ token with their unique character on it. Good players share information to solve the mystery whilst evil players lie about who they are and what they know. The good team wins if they can piece together their knowledge, trust each other, and execute the demon. The evil team wins if the demon can sow distrust, evade detection, and wipe out the village.

title: Autumn Equinox / Mabon Witch Ball Workshop
venue_name: 131 Essex St, Salem, MA 01970-3767, United States
description: Autumn Equinox / Mabon Witch Ball Workshop
long_description:
Please note that we do NOT accept walk-ins. All tickets must be bought in advance of the workshop either in-store or online. Ticket sales end at noon the day prior to the workshop.

Join us at The Sea Wych Salem for an autumn equinox/Mabon experience! We will be celebrating the second harvest, the balance between light and dark, and the turning of the seasonal tides and seas through a brief meditation, and of course, witch crafting. Create your own equinox/Mabon witch ball to celebrate your personal abundant harvest, give gratitude for that harvest, and to channel the energy needed to prepare for the coming autumn and winter. Not only will you be making your own magic, you'll be making your own, one-of-a-kind souvenir and memory from Salem. 

In addition to your witch ball, you'll also be going home with a full ritual kit which will include a sea shell, a tumbled moss agate, a tumbled sun stone, and red and orange spell candles for your altar, as well as all appropriate herbs and sea vegetation, a piece of sea glass, charms, and a ritual written by The Sea Wych Salem for the equinox - and autumn!

Tickets are $85 per person (plus a processing fee of $2.13), and that includes:

- All materials and supplies, including carnelian witch ball toppers made by The Sea Wych Salem specifically for this event, as well as a specially crafted charm.

- A brief history of the witch ball.

- A meditation and short ritual.

long_description:
**From Digital Brochure to Sales Platform:** *A marketer's insights to creating websites that support measurable business growth.*

**Speaker:** Julia Scott, Founder & CEO, J.Scott Marketing

**Description:**
What's the difference between a company website and a landing page designed to convert users into leads? As the owner of a Vermont-based digital marketing agency for 10+ years, we often hear business owners complain that their website isn't generating leads for them. Why not? It's because the goal of a website is different from a landing page that's part of a digital marketing campaign.

Join this interactive presentation to understand and put into practice the key differences between these digital assets so that you can build websites that are more than a digital brochure--but a sales platform.

**Speaker Bio:**
Before forming J.Scott Marketing, Julia Scott worked as a newspaper reporter, contributing to a Pulitzer Prize and starting a website that was featured in the Wall Street Journal, Good Morning America, NPR, and more. Through these adventures, she discovered and mastered many marketing and communications solutions that her team now offers to clients. Julia relishes the unique challenge of building relationships with each of her clients and their teams and is proud to provide data-driven marketing solutions to business owners hungry for concrete results.
When Julia is not being a brand champion for her clients, she loves to be in the woods, train for triathlons, and wake up early.

title: Ramo Re With Jigardan Gadhavi
description: Experience the Vibrancy of Gujarati Tradition with Ramo Re in the Bay Area
long_description:
Experience the Vibrancy of Gujarati Tradition with Ramo Re in the Bay Area
Get ready to immerse yourself in an unforgettable evening of music and dance at the "Ramo Re with Jigardan Gadhavi Garba 2026" on the 25th of September, 2026. This spellbinding event is a unique blend of traditional Gujarati folk music and contemporary sounds, woven together by the talented Jigardan Gadhavi. Experience the magic of Navratri/Dandiya in the heart of the Bay Area and sway to the rhythm of Gujarati, Hindi, Marathi, Punjabi, and Tamil beats.
Meet Jigardan Gadhavi - The Soulful Voice of Gujarat
Jigardan Gadhavi, better known as Jigrra, is a celebrated name in the Indian music industry. His roots in Gujarat have shaped his music, infusing it with the rich cultural heritage of the region. Jigardan's soulful voice and heartfelt compositions have captured the hearts of Gujarati folk, devotional, and contemporary music lovers alike. His popular hits like “Vhalam Aavo Ne” and “Mogal Taro Aashro” showcase his ability to fuse traditional Gujarati music with modern sounds, creating a unique listening experience for his audience.
Unwind at Baylands Park - The Perfect Venue for a Musical Evening
The event is set to take place at the scenic Baylands Park, located at 999 East Caribbean Drive, Sunnyvale, CA, United States. Baylands Park is renowned for its safety and accessibility, making it an ideal venue for families and friends to gather and enjoy an evening of music and dance. Plenty of parking is available at the venue. After the event, you could also explore the flavors of India at nearby Indian restaurants, adding the perfect end to your cultural extravaganza.
Grab Your Tickets for an Enthralling Evening
We offer a variety of ticket options to cater to all our guests. Early bird individual and group passes for the Open Air Garba are available at $35.00 and $32.00 respectively. If you are a fan of both Jigardan Gadhavi and Kinjal Dave, grab our combo tickets at early bird discounts of $60.00. We also offer general admission passes and group tickets for the Open Air Garba at $40.00 and $35.00 respectively. For an unforgettable experience, consider our Meet & Greet with Photo option at $100.00. Merchant Booths are also available at $250.00. Hurry and book your tickets now for an unforgettable Navratri/Dandiya night!

description: A nature-based kids yoga training exploring mindfulness, play, and emotional regulation for parents, educators & caregivers.
long_description:
A nature-based kids yoga training exploring mindfulness, play, and emotional regulation for parents, educators & caregivers.

About this Event

Join Emily from Busy Being Kids Yoga at Gorman Heritage Farm on September 26th & 27th from 9 am to 4 pm for a nature-based Kids Yoga Teacher Training for adults to learn how to effectively teach yoga and mindfulness to children.
This immersive 20-hour training is designed for parents, educators, yoga instructors, and anyone who wants to support the emotional well-being of kiddos through movement, mindfulness, creativity, and play. No prior yoga certification is required.
Together, we will explore meaningful ways to help children regulate emotions, build confidence, process big feelings, connect with nature, and develop lifelong mindfulness tools in ways that feel engaging, supportive, and joyful.
The training blends yoga, mindfulness, breathwork, storytelling, music, games, creative expression, and nature-based activities that encourage curiosity, movement, creativity, and emotional wellness.
Participants will learn:
• Age-appropriate yoga poses and sequencing for children
• Breathing and mindfulness techniques to support emotional regulation
• Activities that encourage confidence, focus, creativity, and self-expression
• Nature-based mindfulness practices and sensory engagement
• Creative lesson planning using music, movement, games, and storytelling
• Tools for creating safe, playful, and supportive environments for children
Participants who complete the training will receive a 20-hour certification through Busy Being Kids Yoga that can be used toward teaching children’s yoga classes and incorporating mindfulness-based practices into educational, wellness, childcare, camp, and community settings.

You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. Support local seniors while restoring your mind and body. Join our $50 Community Sound Bath every ticket funds FREE senior yoga classes.

About this Event

Join us for one of our quarterly Community Sound Bath Fundraisers and support a cause that brings movement, connection, and wellness to older adults throughout San Diego County.These special events are designed for anyone who believes in helping seniors thrive. 

Every ticket purchased helps Silver Age Yoga Community Outreach continue providing **FREE senior yoga classes at more than 17 locations throughout San Diego County, as well as live online classes**, ensuring that cost is never a barrier to healthy aging.

Each of our four annual sound baths features a different local San Diego wellness leader, sound healer, or spiritual practitioner, creating a unique experience every time you attend while showcasing the incredible healing community our city has to offer.

During a sound bath, you'll simply relax in a comfortable position while being immersed in the soothing sounds and vibrations of instruments such as crystal singing bowls, gongs, chimes, drums, and other healing instruments. 

There is no experience necessary—just come as you are and allow yourself to receive.Many participants report experiencing:

• Deep relaxation and stress relief
• A calmer, more balanced nervous system
• Greater mental clarity and emotional well-being
• Improved sleep and restoration
• A renewed sense of peace, presence, and connection

Whether you're looking for a meaningful way to support local seniors, nourish your own well-being, or connect with San Diego's vibrant healing community, our Sound Bath Fundraisers offer a beautiful opportunity to do all three.

Together, we can help more older adults experience the life-changing benefits of movement, mindfulness, and community.

long_description:
Explore Teacher Resources for discussing American Indian Boarding Schools & Indigenous resilience in the classroom!

K-12 Educators are invited to join us for a FREE evening of professional learning, reflection, and connection at the Heard Museum. Held in recognition of the National Day of Remembrance for U.S. Indian Boarding Schools, this special program will help educators approach classroom conversations about the American Indian boarding school era and its ongoing impacts with care, accuracy, and respect—while centering Indigenous resilience.

Through engagement with our program partner, the Arizona Department of Education’s Office of Indian Education, a special guest speaker, and a range of educational resources, participants will gain thoughtful perspectives and practical, classroom-ready ideas.

HERE'S WHAT'S INCLUDED:

• Exclusive after-hours gallery access to the Away From Home: American Indian Boarding School Stories exhibition.

• A presentation from the Office of Indian Education featuring historical and educational context and practical resources for classroom instruction.

• Insights about creative process and ideas for using literature to open age-appropriate conversations with elementary students provided by a special guest author.

• Opportunities to reflect, exchange resources, and network with fellow educators in the Phoenix area.

• A certificate for three hours of professional development credit.

Register now: https://heard.org/event/k-12-educator-night-beyond-the-boarding-schools/.

description: Hold the Light: A Yoga Practice
long_description:
Join us for another season of Yoga at Cedar Run! All levels are welcomed. This will be a slow vinyasa/yin class. Some flow movement with some deep yin holds! Intentional movement progressing towards strength and healing to make you feel invigorated and relaxed. Breathe in the healing energy of the natural surroundings, heal yourself as you contribute to healing the animals around you.

We will be enjoying our morning yoga in the nature setting of the Pine Barrens. Surrounded by the sounds of nature, the smells of the forest and the morning air, it is sure to calm your mind, body and spirit. This session we will be stretching out in our Wildlife Housing Pavilion as we will take in the sun setting into evening. We will have tea at the nature center as well to help get your body and mind calm, replenished and ready for this session!

Please arrive 10 minutes early at our Nature Center Community Room to use the restroom and check in. If you would like to visit some of our resident wildlife after class we would happy for you to self explore. We would love to introduce you to our friends! Class will start at 6:30pm. 

Please bring your own yoga mat as we do not offer rentals. Props are optional. We have a water refill station for any reusable water bottles. 

Class size of 10. Limited space is available! Grab your spot before we sell out!

Children between the ages of 16-18 must be accompanied by an adult/parent.

No children under 16 may be permitted in the yoga session.

Meet your instructor: Monica Walsh – High Vibrations Association

Monica was first introduced to yoga when her mom brought her to her first class that a friend was teaching at a Synagogue in the late 90s. They attended the class because Monica’s relationship to her newly developing teenage body was not a healthy one. This beautiful, simple, practice opened her eyes to a new path with which to approach the human condition both on and off the mat. Ever since, Monica’s desire for yogic knowledge snowballed

long_description:
*“Starting yoga early on in life makes a big difference for the development of the body and brain. We take care to teach children asanas that are suitable for them.”* – Sadhguru

**Isha Hatha Yoga for Children** offers an introduction to Yoga through simple life-transforming practices. These include:

* **Upa Yoga**: Activates the joints, muscles and energy system
* **AUMkar Meditation**: Enhances focus, memory and mind-body coordination
* **Nadi Shuddhi**: Balances and purifies the system

The practices are an effective preventative for obesity, asthma, sinusitis and other chronic ailments. The program is designed by Sadhguru and conducted by a highly trained instructor.

**Program Guidelines & session information**

* ***Attendance for all the sessions is essential. Since the practices are taught step-by-step, if you miss one session, it will not be possible for you to attend the subsequent following sessions***.
* Please make sure you arrive at least 10 minutes ahead of time, as we may not be able to accommodate latecomers.
* Due to the nature of the practices, we request you to maintain an empty stomach condition when you come for the session. There should be a gap of:
* 2.5 hours from the last full meal,
* 1.5 hours from the last snack,
* 1 hour from the last beverage (excluding water)
* It is recommended to wear comfortable (loose) clothing.
* Bring a yoga mat with you, and a cushion if needed as we will be sitting on the floor.
* As we strive to minimize waste, we recommend bringing a refillable water bottle with you. Refill stations are available.

**[Register Here](https://online.innerengineering.com/en/program-details/isha-hatha-yoga-for-children-cityprogram-10215-macungie-pennsylvania-us-oct-2-2026)**

title: Diwali Play Date 2026
description: Spark curiosity about Diwali with an afternoon of hands-on cultural play for ages 1-7. Back in its 5th year. Limited capacity.
long_description:
Spark curiosity about Diwali with an afternoon of hands-on cultural play for ages 1-7. Back in its 5th year. Limited capacity.

About this Event

The Diwali Play Date is the brainchild of two moms-turned-entrepreneurs who wanted to take their little kids to an event just like this one. There were options galore for fancy parties for grown-ups and outdoor melas filled with vendors, but nothing quite like this. So, as typical entrepreneurs, they turned their challenge into an idea. And just like that, Diwali Play Date was born in 2022 in Los Angeles.
Five years, three cities, and every single one sold out. This year we're bringing it home - back to New Jersey, back to the Park Villa - for an afternoon of masti, music, mehndi, and the mess (yes, there will be that) of all things Diwali. If you've caught glimpses of our past events, then you know we take fun pretty seriously around here.
Come dressed in your favorite comfortable cultural festive wear for a jam-packed afternoon of delights for all your senses. Kids will make rangoli with colored rice and lentils, paint their own diyas, get mehndi, let loose in the Bollywood dance workshop, curl up for storytime, and so, SO, SO much more (see the agenda below for a sneak peek).
If you've been wondering what to do with the kids for Diwali this year, or where to take them, or what's even happening near you - this is it. This is the thing you're searching for. Grab your tickets before they're gone... because they WILL go.
It's designed for ages 2 through 7, though the grown-ups tend to have just as much fun.
One note: every guest needs a ticket, adults included, and the venue has a limited capacity. Little ones under 1 are free, but still need a ticket so we can plan for them.
Kick off the Diwali season with us and create core memories with your family.

About this Event

Salt Lake Healthy Life & Wellness Fair"Where Modern Medicine Meets Traditional Vitality"
The Salt Lake Healthy Life & Wellness Fair is an annual, free-admission community health event organized by a local regional non-profit organization. Moving into its 5th consecutive year, the event serves as a trusted cultural and clinical bridge in Salt Lake County.
The fair focuses on breaking down systemic and linguistic barriers to healthcare by providing direct access to medical screenings, insurance literacy, and holistic lifestyle practices.

title: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening
description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. I bet you haven’t laughed like this in months and will feel lighter afterward!
Join us for a fun and rejuvenating session of Laughter Yoga at the Shelley Lake Fishing Pier's top seating area! title: Yoga for a Cause - benefitting Voices for Parkinson's
description: Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Voices for Parkinson's
long_description:
Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Voices for Parkinson's

About this Event

Come flow with us to benefit. Voices For Parkinson's provides in-person and telehealth speech therapy services for residents of Ohio. Individual, 1:1 services are currently provided at Alpha Neuro Fitness (800 E Ross Ave) in Cincinnati, OH. Weekly speech maintenance groups are offered via a hybrid approach, with the option for virtual and/or in-person attendance. The nonprofit organization offers a whole-person approach to treating the symptoms of Parkinson's disease, relating to problems with cognition, voice, and swallowing. We offer resources and education, and collaborate with an interdisciplinary team including local businesses to provide the most up-to-date information to our clients and their community.
100% of all donations go directly to the charity. We thank Fretboard Brewing for donating the space and Anissa Dowling for donating her time and talent in leading the yoga class that is always fun and perfect for all levels.

long_description:
Fall Yoga Retreat: A Refuge for Your Heart

October 16-18, 2026

with Chaya Spencer at Lifebridge Sanctuary, Rosendale, NY

A true refuge is more than a place. It is a space where the mind grows quiet, the body softens, and the heart feels safe. It is where we can set down the weight of daily responsibilities, reconnect with what matters most, and remember the steady center that lives within us. In times of challenge, refuge restores us. In times of ease, it deepens our connection to ourselves and to one another.

Join us for a nourishing weekend retreat at Lifebridge Sanctuary, nestled in the beauty of the Catskills. Through yoga, meditation, time in nature, wholesome meals, meaningful conversation, and spacious periods of rest and reflection, you’ll be invited to slow down and settle into a deeper sense of presence and belonging.

In the yogic tradition, there is a beautiful Sanskrit phrase: hridaya vishranti—reposing in the heart. Here, “heart” does not refer to the physical organ or even the emotional heart, but to our essential nature, the innermost core of who we are. Vishranti means rest, repose, or deep relaxation. Together, these words point to the experience of resting in our own being, returning home to ourselves.

This retreat offers a supportive cocoon for renewal and self-discovery. Come away for a weekend of rest, connection, and renewal. Return home grounded, refreshed, and reconnected to the essence of who you are.

Our retreat center, Lifebridge Sanctuary, offers us a space of peace, nature and quiet to introspect, practice yoga, eat well and rest in beauty inside and out. The Sanctuary is a 12,000 square foot hand crafted, green facility on 95 acres of forest and spectacular open space on the Northern crest of the Shawangunk Ridge, less than 90 minutes from Shree.

title: REZN
venue_name: 7 S Broadway, Denver, CO, United States, Colorado 80209
description: REZN
long_description:
REZN – the Chicago-based band of Rob McWilliams (vocals, guitar), Phil Cangelosi (bass), Patrick Dunn (drums), and Spencer Ouellette (synth/saxophone) – announce their new album, Burden, out June 14th via their new label Sargent House. In conjunction, they present its massive lead single/video, “Chasm.” Since their inception, REZN have mined the stark monochromatic depths of underground metal and fused them with the kaleidoscopic delights of psychedelia, prog rock, and shoegaze. With their latest album Burden, they plumb the deepest, bleakest trenches of their sound while retaining a lifeline into the cosmos. Staking a claim at the crossroads of the hazy dimensions of modern psych acts like Black Angels, the cavernous gloom and reverb-drenched guitar of bands like Spectral Voice, and the lurching low-end meditations of artists like OM, REZN have created Burden—an album of immense amp-worshipping weight and intoxicating instrumentation.

Burden was recorded simultaneously with their previous album Solace back in July 2021 at Earth Analog Studios in Tolono, IL by Matt Russell. Rather than release a double album, REZN divided the material into two separate records, each with its own distinct emotional timbre. Whereas Solace was meant to uplift and create a sense of narcotic dreaminess, Burden skews towards the themes of delirium, claustrophobia, and misery. Musically, Burden favors riffs over atmosphere, percussion over ether, dissonance over beauty, but there is still an undeniable cohesion between it and its predecessor. The marriage of brute force and sublime textures has always been a key tactic in REZN’s approach—a duality that may explain their touring history with fellow synesthesia-inducing metallurgists Elder and Russian Circles—but the spectrum of the band’s mercurial temperaments has never felt as clearly defined and fully explored as it does on Burden.

title: Trauma Informed Yoga Teacher Training
venue_name: Pilgrimage of the Heart Yoga - Normal Heights
description: Trauma informed yoga aims to create a welcoming space for anyone who is experiencing the difficulties that can result from traumatic events.
long_description:
Trauma informed yoga aims to create a welcoming space for anyone who is experiencing the difficulties that can result from traumatic events.

About this Event

Trauma is an emotional response to a stressful or disturbing incident or physical injury. When one experiences a traumatic event, it can create an inner environment that will affect many aspects of the survivor’s life. From a sense of disconnection to a dysregulated nervous system, the impact of trauma reaches both the mind and the body and can leave one with feelings of insecurity, overwhelm and powerlessness that can distance the survivor from their innate sense of joy and inner peace.
Yoga has many tools that can reconnect practitioners to their inner peace and well-being, but for those living with the inner wound of trauma, a regular yoga class may present challenges that keep them from enjoying the many benefits of the practice.
Trauma informed yoga aims to create a welcoming space for anyone who is experiencing the difficulties that can result from traumatic events.
Join Lauren McLaren to investigate the impact of trauma and explore how to make your classes inclusive and sensitive to the needs of those who are living with the effects of trauma.
During this 14-hour training, you will learn:
How trauma can affect physical health and well-beingThe neurobiology of trauma and how yoga can assist in regulating the nervous system to help reconnect the body/mind systemsHow to use practices including asana, pranayama, mudra and mindfulness to promote empowerment and agencyHow to honor trauma survivors in yoga classes by tailoring language and cues, providing consistency in structure, and offering modificationsThis training is perfect for teachers who want to create a more inclusive teaching environment as well as for practitioners who are looking to advance their knowledge in how yogic tools can serve this population.
Please note that this training is not intended to empower teachers to diagnose or treat trauma

Andrew Fisher (vocals) - Alex Henery (guitar) - Ronan Crix (guitar), Duncan Stewart (bass) James Fisher (drums) 

The fourth full-length from Basement, Beside Myself is an intimate look at the drawbacks of living in your own head, and the attempt to shake off everyday anxieties. “One of the things everyone in the band seems to struggle with is living fully in the present time,” says Andrew Fisher, who co-founded the Ipswich, England-bred five-piece in 2010. “We tend to look back on the past and think, ‘That was so much better than what’s going on now,’ or look toward the future and assume it’s going to be better than today. The title came from thinking about, ‘Wouldn’t it be great if you could stop yourself from doing that, and just appreciate the moment as it happens?’” 

But for all its intense introspection and confessions of self-consciousness, Beside Myself centers on a powerful, passionately charged sound that makes every track feel deeply cathartic. A relentless burst of pure vitality, the album expresses its unrest in the language of furious guitar riffs and visceral rhythms. And at the heart of Beside Myself are Basement’s indelible melodies, an element that lends an anthemic quality to even the most heavy-hearted songs. 

The follow-up to Promise Everything—a 2016 album whose re-release the following year marked Basement’s debut for Fueled by Ramen—Beside Myself was co-produced by the band and Colin Brittain, and mixed by Rich Costey (Arctic Monkeys, Foo Fighters, Muse). In creating the album, Basement focused on channeling the raw energy of their live performance, adding little adornment beyond the occasional synth line or piano melody. title: Goat Yoga in The Patch @ Bedford Public Library!
description: Goat Yoga in The Patch @ Bedford Public Library!
long_description:
Come and join us for Goat Yoga in The Patch hosted by the Bedford Public Library!

About this Event 
 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events2/banners/dcb6ced0-87e3-11f1-b6c8-ef4137d8dcb0-rimg-w663-h740-dca7c3f1-gmir.jpg 

YOU are invited to GOAT YOGA in BEDFORD, TX! Come and get your yoga on while our tribe of pet goats graze and jump around (or on) you! We will be in the pumpkin patch at the Bedford Public Library! Come as you are or dressed up in Halloween costume attire. The goats will be in costume!
Please come dressed for the weather as the event will be outside. Proceeds from this class directly benefit our animals and our local non-profit initiatives. 

Know before you go:
*Please do not enter the fenced off goat yoga area any earlier than 15 minutes before your scheduled class time. We will set aside time after class for extra socializing and picture taking with the goats if you don't get the shot you want during yoga practice.
 *BYOM (bring your own yoga mat) We do not provide mats, but we do provide beach towels for all attendees to use. We also provide bottled waters, sunscreen, bug spray, etc.
*Be prepared for our goats to take an interest in you! They are excited to be with you! Goat yoga is for everyone, and we welcome participants age 5 and over (with a participating parent or guardian). It is meant to be fun and memorable. Goats have been known to nudge, scratch, nibble, jump and step on attendees. Goats are NOT potty trained animals. There will be a sanitizing station and antibacterial wipes available.
*Everyone will need to check in and sign our liability waiver before the class starts. Masks are not required. This is an outdoor fitness event. Social distancing will be the responsibility of each participant in regards to their own preferences in proximity to other attendees.

Our tribe looks forward to meeting you!

Let us know if you have any questions or if we can provide you with any additional information - we look forward to hosting you!

title: Marine Corps Marathon 2026 — The People's Marathon
description: The third-largest US marathon and world's largest with no prize money. Run past DC's monuments with Marines cheering you on.
long_description: Known as 'The People's Marathon,' the Marine Corps Marathon is the third-largest marathon in the US and the world's largest without prize money. The 51st edition takes runners on a spectacular tour of Washington DC — past the Pentagon, along the Potomac, through Georgetown, around the National Mall, and past the Capitol. US Marines manage every mile, handing out hydration, cheering runners on, and placing finisher medals. The emotional 'wear blue: run to remember' mile honors fallen service members. Registration opens April 6.
venue_info: Start: Pentagon parking lot, Arlington, VA. Finish: Marine Corps War Memorial (Iwo Jima). Metro (Pentagon station, Blue/Yellow lines) is the best way to get there. Health & Fitness Expo at the National Building Museum. 6-hour time limit.

title: Body & Soul Art Intensive with Alex Grey & Allyson Grey
description: Body & Soul Art Intensive with Alex Grey & Allyson Grey
long_description:
ABOUT THE PROGRAM

Body & Soul Art Intensive is a creative spiritual practice and visionary ritual intended to turn on the Light Body. Multiple systems of subtle healing life energies run through and surround our body. Seven Chakras, witnessed and reported by clairvoyants as "wheels of light,” ascend the spine and color our emotions and aspirations.

This drawing ritual challenges us to depict the model’s nude presence and encourages us to imagine and portray bio-energetic radiant auras that extend beyond the skin.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Drawing begins on the first morning of the workshop. Each of the seven chakra drawings are briefly introduced by a short guided meditation to consider the energetic force-field associated with the chakra we are about to portray. 

Each participant will create seven drawings focusing on the character and hue of one chakra. Each drawing period is forty-five minutes long, working with meditative focus. The exercise is accompanied by a thematic musical playlist highlighting the archetypal meaning of each chakra. 

To introduce each drawing, a brief blessing describes the meaning, color and vibration of that energy center, identifying specific organs and nerve bundles that correspond within the body. The subject of each drawing is a yogini, a nude model who stands, sits or lies still for class members to draw or paint. 

YOUR INSTRUCTORS

Alex Grey & Allyson Grey

Alex Grey, world-renowned artist, poet, and author, is best loved for his paintings which portray multiple dimensions of reality, interweaving biological anatomy with psychic and spiritual energies. His books, Sacred Mirrors, The Mission of Art, Transfigurations, and Art Psalms, trace the development of his work and mystical experiences that shaped his spiritual artistic life. Alex’s most recent monograph, Net of Being, addresses how his art is evolving the cultural body through icons of interconnectedness. alexgrey.com

Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? title: Yoga for a Cause - benefitting Give Like a Mother
description: Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Give Like a Mother - Clothing Kids in Confidence
long_description:
Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Give Like a Mother - Clothing Kids in Confidence

About this Event

Come flow with us to benefit Give Like a Mother. Give Like A Mother (GLAM) is a nonprofit dedicated to ensuring that local children and teens in need have access to seasonally appropriate clothing.
Though we operate on donations of gently used items, we are committed to providing high-quality, in-style clothing that kids can wear with confidence. When children feel good about what they’re wearing, it can boost their self-worth, reduce the risk of ridicule, and ultimately support their success in school and beyond.
Our name may be fun and a little sassy, but it carries a serious challenge. Mothers give everything they can for their children—yet sometimes, even that isn’t enough.
That’s why we’re asking you: Will you Give Like A Mother and help a child in need?
100% of all donations go directly to the charity. We thank Fretboard Brewing for donating the space and Anissa Dowling for donating her time and talent in leading the yoga class that is always fun and perfect for all levels.
Bring a friend and enjoy $1 off beers in the tap room after class!

long_description:

title: BMW Dallas Marathon 2026
description: Dallas's premier marathon weekend with full marathon, half, ultra, 5K, and relay options. Benefits Scottish Rite for Children.
long_description: The BMW Dallas Marathon has been a Texas running tradition for over 40 years. The race weekend features a full marathon, half marathon, ultra marathon, 5-person relay, 10K, and 5K — something for every runner. The course starts at Dallas City Hall, loops through scenic White Rock Lake, and finishes back downtown. Since 1997, the marathon has donated nearly $5 million to Scottish Rite for Children. The December timing provides cool running weather, and the event has sold out three consecutive years.
venue_info: Start/finish at Dallas City Hall, 1500 Marilla St. The course is flat and fast, passing through downtown Dallas and around White Rock Lake (120m total elevation gain). DART light rail serves the City Hall area. Post-race party with food, beer, and live music.

The Winter Solstice marks the longest night of the year—a sacred turning point where we pause, exhale, and return to the quiet center within. It is a time of stillness, dreaming, and deep restoration.
Join Tej and Ray for a candlelit journey into the heart of winter. Through original music, guided Yoga Nidra, breathwork, and immersive sound healing, you’ll be held in a space of warmth, wonder, and renewal.
The Journey Includes:
🌅 Original songs by Ray to open and close the ceremony

🎶 Live music, poetry, and moments of deep stillness
🌬 Breathwork to soothe the nervous system and settle the body
🌀 Meditation journey with kaleidoscope visuals, crystal bowls, djembe, and gong
🎼 Full sound healing immersion while resting in stillness
🌙 Closing intention ritual and shared resonance to carry forward
🧺 What to Bring:

Blanket, bolster, pillow, or anything for deep comfort

Water bottle

title: San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
description: Experience the Vibrance of Tamil Culture at the San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
long_description:
Experience the Vibrance of Tamil Culture at the San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
Mark your calendars for December 31st, 2026, as on this day, the San Diego Tamil Sangam will host its highly anticipated Annual Membership event. A cultural extravaganza that celebrates the richness and diversity of Tamil heritage, this event is a golden opportunity for Tamil enthusiasts to come together and revel in the vibrancy of this ancient culture. The event is sure to be a hub of engagement, enrichment, and entertainment that fosters the promotion and preservation of Tamil language, arts, and literature.
Artist: A Secret Yet to be Revealed
The event is yet to announce its artist, but it's known for featuring renowned individuals from the Tamil community who have significantly influenced the preservation and promotion of Tamil culture. The mystery guest, no doubt, will offer a memorable experience, showcasing the beauty of Tamil arts and literature that resonates with the audience and deepens their appreciation for this rich culture.
Immerse Yourself in Tamil Culture in the Heart of San Diego
The event takes place in San Diego, California, specifically at the 750 B Street location. The venue is in an easily accessible area of the city, known for its safety and proximity to a variety of attractions. After the event, guests can explore the city's vibrant nightlife, historical landmarks, and breathtaking beaches. And for those craving authentic Indian cuisine, there are numerous Indian restaurants nearby where you can indulge in a variety of flavorful dishes.
Secure Your Membership: Ticket Information
Various membership options are available for purchase, ensuring there's something for everyone. The Annual Family Membership is priced at $60.00, providing an excellent opportunity for families to be part of the Tamil community in San Diego. The Annual Individual Membership is available for $35.00, perfect for individuals passionate about Tamil culture. Additionally, the Student Membership from India is priced at a discounted rate of $10.00. For those who want to make a long-term commitment, the Lifetime Membership is available for $500.00. Make sure to secure your membership and be part of the San Diego Tamil Sangam's thriving community.

In 2024, he made his late-night debut on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, and in 2025 released his first
long_description:
Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City. He is currently a finalist on Kevin Hart’s Funny AF for Netflix, which premiered on April 20. In 2024, he made his late-night debut on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, and in 2025 released his first half-hour special with Don’t Tell Comedy on YouTube. The special highlights his signature high-energy, rapid-fire style, with material ranging from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating misadventures and even getting kicked off America’s Got Talent.

As an actor, Usama has appeared in Netflix’s Inventing Anna and Survival of the Thickest, HBO’s And Just Like That, Comedy Central’s Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens, and FX’s Better Things. He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy Best of the Best, alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

Usama was named a New Face at the prestigious Just For Laughs Festival in 2018. In 2020, he reached the semifinals of America’s Got Talent and appeared in the ABC Discovers Talent Showcase. A decorated festival performer, he was a finalist in the 2017 New York’s Funniest competition at Caroline’s and the NBC Stand-Up competition, and has won top honors at the Laughing Devil Cup Comedy Festival (2016), Yonkers Comedy Festival (2015), and Make Me Laugh Albany Comedy Festival (2015). His work has also been featured by NBC, BuzzFeed, Refinery29, The Scene, Mic.com, FusionTV, and The Huffington Post.

Join us in San Francisco for a transformative yoga gathering designed to support well-being, deepen self-awareness, and cultivate resilience in an ever-changing world. More than a conference, this experience is a journey of personal transformation, collective connection, and conscious living.
Led by a diverse faculty of visionary teachers and wellness practitioners, this immersive gathering weaves together the enduring teachings of yoga with contemporary tools for embodied, balanced living. Participants will explore a wide range of integrative practices—including asana, pranayama, meditation, philosophy, Yoga Nidra, Ayurveda, sound healing, yoga for recovery and nervous system support—to build a comprehensive tool-kit for life both on and off the mat.
Whether you’re a lifelong student or a seasoned teacher, this gathering offers a rare opportunity to pause, reflect, and reconnect—with your body, your breath, your community, and the Earth. In a world that moves fast, this is your invitation to slow down and remember what truly matters.
